jobs.title: Equity, Systems and Process Improvement Community Program Specialist II - IHSS (Open)
jobs.description:
San Mateo County Health is seeking a dynamic and experienced leader to serve as the **Equity, Systems and Process Improvement Community Program Specialist II – In-Home Supportive Services Public Authority (ESPI CPS II)** within Aging and Disability Services (ADS).

This position supports the ongoing improvement and modernization of the In-Home Supportive Services (IHSS) Public Authority (PA) by developing automated systems, dashboards, and digital tools that enhance program operations, service accessibility, and staff productivity. The role also assists with caregiver recruitment and onboarding, referral coordination, and the development of policies, procedures, and training materials, while ensuring that all initiatives incorporate racial equity, diversity, and inclusion principles.

**Important Note:** The IHSS PA ESPI Community Program Specialist **is not a County classified position;** however, the role reports directly within ADS. The eligible list generated from this recruitment may be used to fill future extra-help, term, unclassified and regular classified vacancies.

This is a full-time position working Monday–Friday. A hybrid schedule may be available; however, approximately four on-site workdays per week are anticipated based on operational needs and County requirements. The position is currently located in San Mateo, CA, but will relocate to South San Francisco, CA, planned for March 2027. The role requires travel throughout the County and periodic travel within the State of California.

**About the IHSS Public Authority**

Established by the San Mateo County Board of Supervisors in 1993, the IHSS Public Authority administers the care provider components of the County’s IHSS program.

IHSS supports Medi-Cal eligible individuals who are aged, blind or living with disabilities at any age so they can safely remain in their homes as an alternative to institutional care.

**The IHSS Public Authority:**

* Serves as the employer of record for approximately 10,000 IHSS care providers
* Operates a Registry that recruits, screens, and refers care providers to IHSS recipients
* Conducts background checks in accordance with IHSS regulations
* Provides training opportunities to enhance care provider skills
* Offers support to both recipients and care providers to promote successful working relationships
* Administers payroll, personnel services, health benefits, and COBRA
* Maintains employment records, conducts verifications, and responds to subpoenas
* The IHSS PA is advised by the Public Authority Advisory Committee (PAAC), appointed by the Board of Supervisors, with a majority of the members being current or former IHSS recipients and/or care providers.

**Key Responsibilities**

**The** **IHSS PA ESPI Community Program Specialist** **will:**

* Assist in development and maintenance of systems, automated tools, and improvement charters designed to boost IHSS PA operations utilizing both AAS’ Racial Equity Action Plan (REAP) and LEAP process improvement standards
* Implement Quality Assurance (QA) standards in the development and maintenance of dashboards and reporting systems that will be used in IHSS PA work processes, as well as monitor staff workload and productivity
* Assist in the development and maintenance of a self-service portal for referral submissions by external entities
* Assist in the development and maintenance of an online job board intended to help match IHSS recipients with care providers, implementing equity, diversity, and inclusion standards.
* Assist in the migration of paper-driven onboarding processes to digital processes, a process that will expedite accessibility of newly hired care providers to IHSS recipients
* Assist in recruiting and onboarding care providers, to help remediate the current care provider shortage, utilizing a racial equity lens
* Work with the IHSS PA Supervisors to devise, triage, and assign referrals to Payroll Specialists and Registry Social Workers
* Work closely with IHSS Community Program Analysts in the development and maintenance of automation-related projects designed to enhance the accessibility of Payroll and Registry services for IHSS recipients
* Update existing and create new IHSS PA policies and procedures to reflect current and new programmatic practices
* Update existing training materials and training IHSS PA staff, integrating a social and equity lens

The **ideal candidate** will be:

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, well suited for large government or non-profit social service programs.
* Experience working with case management databases like the Case Management, Information and Payrolling Services (CMIPS II) and Microsoft Suite Applications (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Excel).
* Experience with process improvement best practices and LEAP process improvement principles and methodologies.
* Experience training community members and/or staff in programmatic updates and new operational requirements requiring updated work practices.
* Strong understanding of social and racial equity principles leading to the County of San Mateo’s Equity Framework.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Knowledge of:**

* Principles, practices, and administrative requirements of the program to which assigned.
* Contemporary social, political and economic trends and problems related to community services.
* Principles of social planning and program development related to community services.
* Specialized technical knowledge related to assigned program area.
* Monitoring and evaluating systems for community services programs.
* Current social and community needs.
* Principles and practices in community development and services planning.
* Methods applied to the collection and evaluation of statistical data.
* Principles of community organization.
* Applicable federal, state and local laws, rules and regulations and County and program policies and guidelines.
* Computer applications related to the work.
* Office ad

jobs.title: Program Coordinator, Equitable Building Decarbonization Program
jobs.description:
Job Title: Program Coordinator – Equitable Building Decarbonization Program  
Primary Work Location: San Francisco – Bay Area (Hybrid)  
FLSA Classification: Exempt  
Projected Salary Range: $55,000 - $75,000

Overview: Association for Energy Affordability (AEA) is a rapidly growing national nonprofit energy services and training organization dedicated to reducing the carbon impact of the built environment while fostering and maintaining affordable and healthy housing and communities. Energy consulting services are completed through AEA’s participation in a variety of federal, state, and local energy programs and initiatives. For more information about AEA, see http://www.aea.us.org.

Position Summary: AEA West is seeking a Program Coordinator to join our tight-knit, talented team of “Energy Geeks”. The candidate must be passionate about energy efficiency and green building, highly organized, detail-oriented, and have strong communication skills.
  
  
The Program Coordinator will assist one or more of AEA’s Program Associates and/or Program Managers in the day-to-day operations and process flow of programs directed at providing energy efficiency and building decarbonization services for multifamily buildings. The Program Coordinator will work collaboratively with AEA’s Program Associates and/ or Program Managers who manage and support program implementation oversee and coordinate with technical staff, analyze program and pilot data, coordinate with external parties, conduct outreach and intake. The Program Coordinator engages in project scheduling, marketing and outreach, data analysis, report production, special program projects/ pilots, and database management as needed to deliver high impact energy efficiency and building decarbonization programs. They are expected to be a self-starter, an independent problem solver, and a strong team-player with a customer-service orientation.

AEA is hiring for primary work locations based in the Bay Area. Candidates must have the ability to travel within California upon request.

Responsibilities:
  
The Program Coordinator may be expected to assist with:

* Supporting energy efficiency, renewable energy and/or building decarbonization program implementation.
* Supporting technical staff conducting energy audits and in-field energy assessments, on-site diagnostics, field data collection and analysis as needed.
* Gathering, analyzing, and reporting program data such as program pipeline, measure savings, benchmarking and other utility data, project savings, regional project distribution, etc.
* Implementing special projects within a program.
* Conducting outreach and intake to program participants and stakeholders.
* Developing program materials, forms, process documents.
* Supporting invoicing and budget reconciliation
* Supporting data entry and data quality control
* Developing and updating marketing materials, email templates, presentations and websites.
* Communicating about the program to stakeholders including inquiries received from general program email inbox and hotline as well as representing the program at conferences and in-person events and tours as needed.

These job responsibilities may be revised over time to ensure the functional responsiveness of the Program Coordinator to AEA and Federal and California State program requirements.

Minimum Qualifications:  

* Bachelor’s degree or an Associate degree.
* One (1) year of related experience in a related role.
* Basic knowledge and experience in energy efficiency and green building principles.
* Strong oral and written communication skills.
* Ability to bring together various resources to work together collaboratively.
* Advanced-level knowledge of MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

Additional Qualifications Desired:  

* Basic knowledge and understanding of Title 24 and other building codes and standards.
* Familiarity with local, state, and federal incentive and rebate programs.
* Sound technical writing skills and experience.
* Proficiency in Salesforce.

Must be able to legally work in the country where this position is located without visa sponsorship.

**EEO Non-Discrimination and ADA Reasonable Accommodation Statement:**  
Applicants are considered for all positions without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, national origin, immigration or citizenship status, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital or partnership status, disability, military status, veteran status, or predisposing genetic characteristics. AEA does not discriminate on the basis of physical or mental disability where the essential functions of the job can be reasonably accommodated. Determinations on requests for reasonable accommodation will be made on a case-by-case basis. For more information on the physical requirements of this position and/or if you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application and hiring process, please notify Human Resources at 718-292-6733 ext. 8265.

We maintain an inclusive culture where everyone feels safe to contribute and help us innovate, and we encourage people from diverse backgrounds to apply to our roles.

TO APPLY: Interested applicants must submit a cover letter and resume to be considered. In your cover letter, please share examples of AEA’s past or current work that is most exciting to you and why. We will not be reviewing resumes without a cover letter.

You may find all our open positions at our Careers site here: https://aea.us.org/about/#careers

AEA offers excellent benefits, including medical/dental/vision, commuter plan, 401(k) w/matching contribution, generous PTO, educational assistance, paid parental leave, hybrid work arrangement and many development opportunities. We are also an eligible employer for student loan forgiveness.

jobs.title: HR Generalist
jobs.description:
Therm-x of California is the leading manufacturer for Advanced Temperature and Control Systems for Hi-Technology industries. We have been in business for over 30 years and have a diverse customer base. **We offer competitive pay, and a comprehensive benefits package.**

The Human Resources Generalist is responsible for supporting and administering a variety of HR functions, including employee relations, recruitment, workers’ compensation administration, offboarding, performance management, compliance, training, and employee engagement.

This position serves as a resource to employees and managers, providing guidance on HR policies, procedures, and best practices. The ideal candidate is organized, detail-oriented, approachable, and capable of handling confidential employee matters while balancing multiple priorities in a fast-paced work environment.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities;**

Employee Relations

* Serve as a primary point of contact for employee questions, concerns, and workplace matters.
* Assist with employee relations issues, workplace investigations, and conflict resolution.
* Provide guidance to managers regarding performance concerns, attendance, and corrective action.
* Promote a positive, inclusive, and respectful workplace culture.

Workers’ Compensation

* Coordinate and administer the workers' compensation process, including reporting, documentation, and follow-up on workplace injuries and illnesses.
* Assist with reviewing work restrictions and ensuring appropriate accommodations are considered in accordance with applicable laws.
* Provide guidance to employees and managers regarding workers' compensation procedures, reporting requirements, and applicable HR policies.

Benefits and Leave Administration

* Assist with employee benefits enrollment and ongoing benefits administration.
* Respond to employee questions regarding health insurance, retirement plans, and other benefits.
* Coordinate leave requests, including FMLA/CFRA, PDL/PFL, and other applicable leave programs.

HR Compliance and Administration

* Maintain employee personnel files and confidential HR records.
* Ensure compliance with applicable federal, state, and local employment laws.
* Assist with HR audits, reporting, and employment documentation.
* Monitor required employment forms, certifications, and policy acknowledgments.

Performance Management and Training

* Coordinate annual and periodic employee performance evaluations.
* Support managers with performance improvement plans and employee development.
* Identify training needs and coordinate professional development opportunities.
* Assist with maintaining HR policies, procedures, and employee handbook updates.

Employee Engagement and Retention

* Support employee engagement initiatives and organizational culture programs.
* Assist with employee recognition, retention, and workplace wellness activities.
* Conduct or coordinate employee feedback surveys.
* Identify opportunities to improve employee satisfaction and workplace effectiveness.

**Desired Skills;**

* Working knowledge of CA employment laws, HR policies, and HR best practices.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, ADP Workforce Now and Workforce Manager
* Experience with recruitment, employee relations, workers’ compensation, performance management, benefits administration, and HR operations.
* Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to manage sensitive and confidential situations with tact, professionalism, and diplomacy.
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* 5-8 years of progressive experience in Human Resources
* Professional HR certification (PHR, SHRM-CP, or equivalent) preferred.

**Position Qualifications;**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty and responsibility satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Physical Demands:** While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to be in a stationary position; move within the facilities, constantly operate computer equipment, inspect surroundings and documentation, communicate with others, detect odors, and occasionally transport office materials up to 20 pounds

**Work Environment:** moderate tohigh noise level associated with manufacturing facility

jobs.title: Case Manager (Tagalog)
jobs.description:
**CASE MANAGER I and II (Tagalog)**

**Case Manager I Bilingual - $2,741.57 - $3,993.25 Bi-weekly; $71,280.82 - $103,824.50 Annual**

**Case Manager II Bilingual - $2,846.40 - $4,148.14 Bi-weekly; $74,006.40 - $107,851.64 Annual**

**New hires with no prior Regional Center work experience will start at the very beginning of the salary scale.**

**\* Please note that our new hire date is anticipated to be Monday, January 4th \***

The Regional Center of the East Bay (RCEB) is one of 21 Regional Centers that are community-based, private non-profit corporations under contract with the California Department of Developmental Services. RCEB provides intake, assessment, diagnosis, and coordinates community-based services for over 25,000 children and adults with developmental disabilities in Alameda and Contra Costa counties.

RCEB envisions a future where persons with developmental disabilities are truly a part of the community. Persons with developmental disabilities receive supports and services they need to succeed. The supports and services change as the need changes.

In our dream, children with developmental disabilities live with families in typical communities. Many choose to attend their neighborhood schools and play with neighborhood friends. Adults with developmental disabilities live in the residence of their choice – with family members, with friends, or with their spouse / significant other. They engage in activities of their choice – work, volunteering, education, training, or leisure. They have meaningful relationships with friends and coworkers and are seen as valuable, contributing members of their communities.

**Key Responsibilities**:

**Case Managers** are an integral part of realizing our dream. Under general direction, Case Managers are responsible for the entire case management process, including: assessment and evaluation, planning, authorizing, advocacy, monitoring, reviewing documentation for completion.

* Facilitate the planning process and develop the Individual Program Plan (IPP) or Individual Family Service Plan (IFSP) for assigned Consumers and oversee the implementation of the IPP/IFSP. Monitor and evaluate the services provided through the plan.

* Coordinate and support the implementation of the Consumers plan which may include identifying natural supports and generic services and evaluating when a need exists that can only be met through RCEB authorized funding.

* Advocate on behalf of consumers to protect their rights under the law and ensure that they receive those services and benefits to which they are entitled.

* Assist the consumer and family in obtaining essential diagnosis and evaluation from appropriate practitioners and secure written reports and other information which assesses and interprets the consumer's situation.

* Monitor the consumer's health and safety.

* Maintain all documentation and contacts as required by law, regulation and policy.

* Implement RCEB policies and procedures.

* Complete, in a timely manner, functional and/or developmental reviews.

* Keep supervisor informed of the status of the case load and unmet needs in the community.

* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Minimum Qualification:**

**Case Manager I**

* BA Degree in Social Work, Psychology or a related human services field and 2 years similar experience. OR B.A. in an unrelated human services field plus 4 years of experience working directly with the developmentally disabled.

* Ability to communicate clearly and effectively, verbally and in writing.

* Automobile and valid driver's license required.

* Demonstrate cultural awareness and sensitivity and an ability to work effectively with culturally diverse populations.

* Ability to speak in Tagalog.

**Case Manager II**

* Master's Degree in Social Work, Psychology or related human services field.

* Ability to communicate clearly and effectively, verbally and in writing.

* Automobile and valid driver's license required.

* Demonstrate cultural awareness and sensitivity and an ability to work effectively with culturally diverse populations.

* Ability to speak in Tagalog.

**Benefits:**

At the Regional Center of the Easy Bay, we offer a full spectrum of competitive benefits including:

* 3 weeks paid vacation + 12 sick days
* 14 paid holidays + 3 floating holidays
* Multiple options for medical care (including Kaiser at 100% employer paid for employee)
* Dental and vision plans
* CalPERs Retirement (pension),
* Student Loan Forgiveness\*
* Flex schedule, if applicable
* Work at Home schedules, if applicable
* Employee Assistance Program, including mental health care

  

*RCEB staff are mandated to be vaccinated and receive a booster, when eligible, for COVID-19, by 3/1/2022, per CA Public Health Order (PHO) and DDS directive. The EEOC and California DEFH has noted that, any person who has either (1) a medical condition or disability that prevents taking the vaccine/booster or (2) a sincerely held religious belief, practice, or observance that prevents the person from taking the vaccine/booster may be entitled to an exemption as a reasonable accommodation.*

* *The Public Service Loan Forgiveness program is a federal program that forgives student loan debt for nonprofit employees after 120 qualifying payments. Employees who work at least 30 hours per week for a governmental, 501(c)(3) nonprofit, or other qualifying nonprofit organization may apply to have the balance of their student loans forgiven (tax free) after making 120 monthly payments.*

* May supervise and manage the performance, development, work quality, reporting, and activities of Project Managers, Space Planners, and CAD Operators
* Provide all necessary documentation and reports to the client and building/facility management team
* Cooperate with other building/facility personnel to achieve corporate goals and objectives as to quality, service, cost and profit
* Report to the Account/Portfolio Manager and senior building/facility manager regarding major problems and findings and results achieved along with specific, complete, and comprehensive recommendations
* Provide the appropriate documentation and obtain the approvals necessary in advance of making organizational changes, actions planned, implying commitments, and expenditures in excess of approved budget
* May be required to establish goals and objectives with timetables for the organizational unit and sub-units supervised
* May be required to select and hire subordinates; delegate to each necessary authority and responsibility for performance of assigned functions
* May be required to train, develop, motivate and discipline subordinates as necessary to meet established goals; review and appraise their work performance

1. Client Focus  
2. Communication Proficiency (oral and written)

jobs.title: Operations Manager, Autonomous Safety
jobs.description:
**About The Role**
------------------

As Manager of Operational Safety, you will lead the team responsible for safety systems, incident response, and SOP governance for DoorDash's autonomous robot operations. You will set strategy, build and develop a team of safety specialists, and partner with engineering and product leadership to ensure safety is embedded into every phase of development. This is a senior leadership role for someone who thrives at the intersection of operational rigor and cutting-edge autonomy.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* **Lead and grow the safety team —** hire, develop, and manage a team of operations safety specialists across remote and on-site functions
* **Set SOP strategy —** own the design, governance, and continuous improvement of standard operating procedures; drive compliance across all Labs programs
* **Own safety analytics & reporting —** establish metrics and KPIs for operational safety; present trends, risks, and recommendations to senior leadership
* **Lead incident command —** oversee critical incident triage and resolution; ensure root cause analysis and corrective action processes are rigorous and timely
* **Drive cross-functional safety programs —** partner with engineering, product, legal, and field operations to build safety into product design, launches, and scale
* **Represent safety externally —** engage with regulators, partners, and customers on safety standards and compliance as needed

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

**Required**

* 7+ years in operations, safety, or a related field — autonomy, robotics strongly preferred
* 2+ years managing or leading teams, with a track record of developing talent and building high-performing functions
* Proven experience designing and scaling safety or operational systems in a regulated or safety-critical environment
* Executive presence with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and present complex risk data clearly
* Strong analytical mindset; comfortable with ambiguity and fast-changing priorities
* Participate in on-call rotation and promptly respond to on-call events with urgency and rigor on nights and weekends.

**Preferred**

* Deep familiarity with safety management systems (SMS), ISO 45001, or equivalent frameworks
* Proven track record in designing, developing, and deploying comprehensive training programs and instructional materials.
* Experience with autonomous systems, robotics deployment, or fleet operations at scale
* Proficiency in Google Workspace, Jira, and SQL

**Why This Role**
-----------------

* Build and lead the safety function at one of the most ambitious autonomy teams in tech
* Direct influence over systems that affect millions of real-world interactions
* High visibility to DoorDash senior leadership and a clear path to Director-level growth
* Competitive compensation, equity, and benefits

**About DoorDash**
------------------

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.  
  
DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
---------------------------------------------

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Statement of Non-Discrimination: In keeping with our beliefs and goals, no employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on: race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital/domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability status, or veteran status. Above and beyond discrimination and harassment based on "protected categories," we also strive to prevent other subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (i.e., stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our office. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at DoorDash. We value a diverse workforce – people who identify as women, non-binary or gender non-conforming, LGBTQIA+, American Indian or Native Alaskan, Black or African American, Hispanic or Latinx, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, differently-abled, caretakers and parents, and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply. Thank you to the Level Playing Field Institute for this statement of non-discrimination.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and any other state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with the applicable regulation.

**If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.**

jobs.title: Finance Operations Manager
jobs.description:
### **Description**

**Job Summary**:

The Finance Operations Manager is responsible for the day-to-day management and execution of assigned Finance Operations functions across HNIB. Operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with significant M&A activity, this role takes ownership of core FinOps workstreams, complex operational issues, agency integrations, and process improvements that support the organization’s continued growth.

The position requires hands-on management, strong problem-solving skills, knowledge of the general ledger, and excellent communication skills. The Manager is accountable for the accurate and timely execution of assigned processes, the independent resolution of issues, and close collaboration with Operations and Agency Principals to integrate and streamline newly acquired agencies while maintaining financial integrity.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:**  
Leadership and Team Development

* Manage assigned day-to-day Finance Operations activities across Direct Bill, Cash Receipts, Payables, and related banking functions, with accountability for timely and accurate execution.
* Coach and develop FinOps leads and team members, keeping the team engaged and motivated while adjusting responsibilities to foster growth, accountability, and operational knowledge.
* Take ownership of complex operational issues within assigned areas, drive investigations through resolution, and escalate significant risks or decisions as appropriate.
* Foster a collaborative environment with clear accountability and follow-through, balancing consistent procedures with the evolving needs of the business.

Operations, Process & Systems

* Oversee and improve operational workflows, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and audit compliance while adapting to shifting priorities and building scalable processes as the organization grows.
* Coordinate directly with Accounting, IT, Operations, and Finance leadership to execute system and process changes impacting assigned Finance Operations activities.
* Maintain clear, current process documentation for assigned Finance Operations functions and ensure procedures are followed as processes evolve.
* Drive standardization and efficiency across acquired agencies and operational teams, identifying gaps and implementing practical solutions.
* Serve as the primary Finance Operations liaison to Operations for assigned M&A integrations; own the transition of newly acquired agencies into standardized workflows, resolve integration issues, and coordinate with Accounting and agency teams through implementation.
* Own year-end procedures and audit deliverables for Finance Operations, ensuring timely completion and resolution of outstanding issues.

General Ledger & Cash Management

* Apply strong general ledger knowledge to ensure assigned Finance Operations activity is accurately reflected in financial reporting.
* Own the investigation and resolution of discrepancies between operational subledgers and the general ledger, coordinating with Accounting counterparts as needed.
* Resolve accounting and reconciliation issues arising from operational transactions and guide team members on their financial impact.
* Monitor daily cash positions across HNIB and its subsidiaries, identify funding or liquidity needs, and promptly communicate and act on exceptions.
* Coordinate approved movement and sweeping of excess subsidiary cash, ensuring transactions are accurate, timely, and properly recorded.
* Proactively identify, investigate, and communicate operational issues affecting cash timing, reconciliations, or financial reporting; drive corrective action.

Team Player and Role Model:

* Be a role model for the finance team, embodying the organization's values and promoting a culture of excellence, integrity, and accountability.
* Communicate clearly, directly, and proactively with agency leaders, Operations, Accounting, and other cross-functional teams; own follow-through on issues and commitments.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

Education

* Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in Finance, Accounting, or a related business discipline.

Experience

* 5–7 years of experience in finance, accounting, or financial operations, including 1–3 years of supervisory or management experience.
* Strong general ledger knowledge, problem-solving skills, and written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience with M&A integrations, multi-entity operations, or the insurance industry is a plus.

  

### **Why Choose Heffernan?**

  

At Heffernan, our culture is guided by the Heffernan Habits, prioritizing communication, respect, fun, community impact, and celebrating what makes each of us unique. We’re proud of our strong commitment to philanthropy and giving back, and we support our employees with a comprehensive benefits package designed to promote well-being, growth, and long-term success.
  
  
**Heffernan Habits:**

These are core values that represent our unique culture.

* ***Answer The Phone (And Email):*** Communication is the foundation of success in life, work, and relationships. It begins with being present and responsive to both clients and colleagues. Listen to what is said and notice what goes unsaid.
* ***Have Fun:*** Fun is something we don’t shy away from, and participation brings us together on many different levels. Take the time to know your colleagues and let barriers fall away. If we are happy and enjoy time together, we will do a better job for our clients and for one another!
* ***Be Respectful*****:** Lend a hand, be kind, and smooth the path. Respect is the cornerstone of developing and maintaining strong relationships. Lead with humility, take ownership of your actions, and ease the way for others. We are in this together as a team, as a family, and as trusted advisors to many.
* ***Do Good*****:** This is our core. We strive to do good for our clients, our community, and our planet.

jobs.title: GSOC Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**GSOC Operations Manager**
===========================

The Global Security Operations Center (GSOC) Operations Manager is responsible for leading the daily operations of the Security Operations Center, ensuring effective response to security incidents, compliance requirements, and business continuity events across the enterprise. This role provides strategic and operational leadership to GSOC personnel, including the Assistant Manager, Shift Supervisors, and Operators, while serving as a key liaison between internal stakeholders, third-party vendors, and Global Safety & Security leadership.

The GSOC Operations Manager oversees incident management, security systems, operational excellence initiatives, and regulatory compliance programs. This position requires strong leadership, sound judgment, exceptional communication skills, and extensive experience in security operations, risk management, and crisis response within a fast-paced global environment.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Lead, mentor, and develop GSOC personnel, including Assistant Managers, Shift Supervisors, and Operators, ensuring operational readiness and professional growth.
* Manage all aspects of GSOC operations, including training programs, emergency drills, alarm monitoring audits, incident response procedures, and compliance initiatives.
* Oversee workforce management functions, including scheduling, payroll administration, invoicing, staffing coverage, and key performance indicator (KPI) reporting.
* Monitor, assess, and coordinate responses to global security incidents, threats, and business disruptions that may impact personnel, facilities, or operations.
* Escalate critical incidents to Security Leadership and collaborate with Human Resources, Information Technology, Legal, Facilities, and business leaders to ensure timely resolution.
* Exercise sound judgment and decision-making in accordance with established policies, procedures, and risk management practices.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for third-party managed security service providers and external security partners.
* Conduct investigations related to security incidents, policy violations, workplace concerns, and other sensitive matters, providing detailed reports and recommendations to leadership.
* Manage incidents through full resolution, ensuring accurate documentation, tracking, follow-up, and reporting within incident management systems.
* Partner with Security Systems Engineers, Administrators, Technicians, and vendors to optimize technologies, improve operational processes, and enhance security capabilities.
* Act as the subject matter expert for designated security systems, ensuring maximum utilization of platform functionality and operational effectiveness.
* Track, document, and communicate the status of projects, strategic initiatives, operational improvements, and departmental objectives.
* Support global security programs and initiatives by delivering security services, intelligence analysis, and operational guidance to stakeholders worldwide.
* Collaborate with Global Safety & Security leadership to strengthen the organization's overall security posture, operational efficiencies, and risk mitigation strategies.
* Establish operational goals, identify performance expectations, delegate responsibilities, and ensure accountability across the GSOC team.
* Maintain the highest standards of confidentiality when handling sensitive information, including personnel matters, investigations, medical information, executive protection concerns, and crisis-related communications.
* Communicate effectively with senior leadership regarding critical incidents, operational performance, emerging threats, and strategic security initiatives.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgment and make timely decisions within established policies and procedures.
* Self-motivated professional capable of working independently while managing multiple priorities and meeting deadlines.
* Strong leadership, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Exceptional customer service skills with a professional and diplomatic approach.
* Advanced organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong telephone, dispatch, and incident coordination skills.
* Proficiency with computer systems and ability to quickly learn new technologies and software platforms.
* Ability to effectively prioritize competing responsibilities and respond to high-pressure or emergency situations.
* Experience collaborating with personnel at all organizational levels.
* Demonstrated discretion and ability to manage sensitive and confidential information.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's Degree in Criminal Justice, Security Management, Emergency Management, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Experience managing Security Operations Centers (SOC) or Global Security Operations Centers (GSOC).
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Windows environments.
* Experience with C-CURE 9000 Access Control Systems.
* Experience with Milestone Video Management Systems (VMS).
* Experience with Omnigo iTrak Dispatch and Incident Management Software.
* Experience with ServiceNow or similar workflow and case management platforms.
* Knowledge of corporate security operations, crisis management, incident response, investigations, physical security systems, and risk mitigation programs.

* Experience driving adoption of new tools, practices, processes, or ways of working.

* Strong relationship-building, stakeholder-management, and communication skills across technical and non-technical teams.

jobs.title: Staff Operations Program Manager
jobs.description:
Lightmatter is leading the revolution in AI data center infrastructure, enabling the next giant leaps in human progress. The company invented the world's first 3D-stacked photonics engine, Passage™, capable of connecting thousands to millions of processors at the speed of light in extreme-scale data centers for the most advanced AI and HPC workloads.

Lightmatter raised $400 million in its Series D round, reaching a valuation of $4.4 billion. We will continue to accelerate the development of data center photonics and grow every department at Lightmatter!

If you're passionate about tackling complex challenges, making an impact, and being an expert in your craft, join our team of brilliant scientists, engineers, and accomplished industry leaders.

Lightmatter is (re)inventing the future of computing with light!

Lightmatter's Supply Chain Operations team designs and executes the complex, global manufacturing networks required to build our world-first photonic engines at scale. We partner seamlessly with critical component vendors and Tier-1 manufacturing partners to deliver a resilient, cost-effective, and rapid flow of cutting-edge hardware.

As an Operations Program Manager, you will serve as the primary operational program owner driving supplier execution, Statement of Work governance, and master build planning across silicon foundries, Tier-1/Tier-2 OSATs, and Contract Manufacturers. Operating with high autonomy, you will bridge internal R&D, Packaging Engineering, Quality, and Commercial teams with external vendor leadership to drive NPI builds through to High-Volume Manufacturing.

In this role, you will immediately take operational ownership of active Passage and/or Guide programs. You will maintain complete control over multi-tier material availability tracking, Clear-To-Build readiness, vendor milestone enforcement, and cross-functional schedule alignment.

#### **Core Responsibilities**

* Serve as the senior operational leader owning the complete material development lifecycle from NPI through HVM. You will act as the primary operations counterpart to engineering and quality teams, collaborating directly with external vendors to ensure all hardware materials are realized and available to support the master schedule.
* Drive end-to-end operational execution for assigned electro-optical program lines by aligning customer and internal demand into master build plans spanning silicon foundries, OSATs, and Contract Manufacturers.
* Build and maintain virtual line-item Clear-To-Build (CTB) matrices across multi-tier suppliers. You will track component lead times and drive consigned material staging into OSAT and CM facilities to guarantee unblocked build execution.
* Partner with engineering leads to draft, enforce, and track vendor Statements of Work. You will conduct weekly operational progress reviews, hold suppliers accountable to milestone deliverables, and drive overall vendor execution metrics.
* Actively track and resolve critical-path dependencies that impact external manufacturing, driving internal teams to provide the design freeze sign-offs, ECO cut-ins, and test scripts required by vendor partners to proceed with production.
* Maintain transparent milestone risk logs, material readiness trackers, and build progress dashboards to consistently communicate program status and critical path risks to executive leadership with actionable mitigation plans.
* Own PLM workflows across the product lifecycle, which includes creating and managing Bills of Materials and directly managing the routing and approval of Engineering Change Orders.

#### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business Management, Engineering, or a related field, complemented by relevant operational experience.
* 8+ years of progressive experience in Operations Program Management or Partner Operations within high-tech hardware, semiconductors, optical networking, or silicon photonics.
* Proven track record directly managing external manufacturing partners, contract manufacturers, silicon foundries, or OSATs through complex NPI-to-HVM build cycles.
* Advanced expertise constructing multi-tier master schedules, tracking material availability, and enforcing line-item CTB matrices across multi-stage assembly flows.
* Executive presence, influence, and assertiveness necessary to drive both internal engineering teams and external partner program managers to strict milestone dates.
* Hands-on experience executing BOM management, ECO routing, and revision control within PLM systems, alongside working within ERP/MRP environments.

#### **Preferred Qualifications**

* A Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, or a technical discipline is strongly preferred.
* Highly value direct experience managing operational supplier partnerships specifically in electro-optical packaging, silicon photonics, high-speed optical transceivers, or AI compute hardware.
* Desire a deep understanding of multi-tier semiconductor transitions, from wafer sort through advanced packaging to final module assembly.
* Hands-on experience executing BOM management, ECO routing, and revision control within PLM software (e.g., Arena, Agile, Teamcenter, or similar).

### **Benefits**

* Comprehensive Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
* Retirement Savings Matching Program
* Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
* Generous Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
* Paid Family Leave
* Short Term & Long Term Disability
* Training & Development
* Commuter Benefits
* Flexible, hybrid workplace model
* Equity grants (applicable to full-time employees)

jobs.title: Program Manager, Operations Readiness
jobs.description:
Gatik, the leader in autonomous middle-mile logistics, is revolutionizing the B2B supply chain with its autonomous transportation-as-a-service (ATaaS) solution and prioritizing safe, consistent deliveries while streamlining freight movement by reducing congestion. The company focuses on short-haul, B2B logistics for Fortune 500 retailers and in 2021 launched the world's first fully driverless commercial transportation service with Walmart. Gatik's Class 3-7 autonomous trucks are commercially deployed across major markets, including Texas, Arkansas, and Ontario, Canada, driving innovation in freight transportation.

The company's proprietary Level 4 autonomous technology, Gatik Carrier™, is custom-built to transport freight safely and efficiently between pick-up and drop-off locations on the middle mile. With robust capabilities in both highway and urban environments, Gatik Carrier™ serves as an all-encompassing solution that integrates advanced software and hardware powering the fleet, facilitating effortless integration into customers' logistics operations.

**About the Role**

Gatik is looking for a detail-oriented, highly organized **Program Manager, Operations Readiness** to make sure our operations teams are prepared for every change that reaches the field. In this role, you will manage readiness for software releases, hardware improvements, platform updates, operational process changes, and end-state improvement rollouts, using lean principles and standardized processes. Reporting to the Director of Central Operations, you will act as the primary conduit between Technical Engineering and Operations, and partner closely with Product, Training, and Safety so that every change is enabled, communicated, trained, and validated before launch. You will be instrumental in maintaining safety and operational continuity while driving fast, reliable delivery of improvements across our autonomous fleet.

This role is **hybrid**, **2** days per week in **Santa Clara, Phoenix, Dallas, or Toronto**.

**What You'll Do**

* **Own readiness programs end to end.** Plan and run readiness for software releases, hardware improvements, platform updates, process changes, and end-state rollouts, from early scoping through launch and post-launch stabilization.
* **Standardize the readiness process.** Build and maintain standard work, templates, checklists, and go/no-go gates so every launch follows a consistent, repeatable process.
* **Apply lean principles.** Use lean tools (value stream mapping, waste elimination, root cause analysis) to make readiness and rollout workflows faster, simpler, and less error-prone.
* **Bridge Engineering and Operations.** Act as the conduit between Technical Engineering and Operations: translate technical changes into operational impact, and bring field realities back into engineering priorities.
* **Maintain the operations triage process.** Own the triage process for issues coming out of operations, including intake, prioritization, routing to the right engineering or functional owners, and tracking to resolution.
* **Escalate field feedback.** Collect and synthesize feedback from operations teams, escalate critical issues quickly and clearly, and make sure feedback shapes future releases and improvements.
* **Partner across functions.** Work with Product, Operations, Training, and Safety to align on scope, dependencies, timelines, and owners for each change.
* **Drive training and enablement.** Coordinate with Training to make sure documentation, SOP updates, training content, and field communications are delivered and completed before launch.
* **Manage risk and safety alignment.** Work with Safety to identify operational risks, confirm mitigations are in place, and make sure changes meet safety and regulatory requirements.
* **Coordinate rollouts and close the loop.** Plan phased or market-by-market rollouts, serve as the single point of coordination at launch, and run retrospectives to improve the process.

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of experience in program management, operations, or launch management.
* Experience managing cross-functional programs with several stakeholders, including technical engineering teams.
* Experience building or running an issue triage, intake, or escalation process.
* Working knowledge of lean principles and process standardization.
* Experience preparing operations teams for product, technology, or process changes.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including turning technical information into clear operational guidance.
* Experience with program management and issue tracking tools such as Jira, Confluence, Asana, or Smartsheet.
* Experience in autonomous vehicles, trucking, logistics, or fleet operations preferred.
* Lean Six Sigma Yellow or Green Belt, or equivalent lean training preferred.
* Experience supporting software or hardware release cycles in a technology or robotics environment preferred.
* Familiarity with safety-critical operations and change management processes preferred.
* Experience working with training and enablement teams to roll out SOPs and field training preferred.
* PMP, CSM, or similar program management certification preferred.
* Experience in a high-growth or startup environment preferred.

**More about Gatik**

Founded in 2017 by experts in autonomous vehicle technology, Gatik has rapidly expanded its presence to Mountain View, Dallas-Fort Worth, Arkansas, and Toronto. As the *first and only* company to achieve fully driverless middle-mile commercial deliveries, Gatik holds a unique and defensible position in the AV industry, with a clear trajectory toward sustainable growth and profitability.

We have delivered complete, proprietary AV technology - an integration of software and hardware - to enable earlier successes for our clients in constrained Level 4 autonomy.

jobs.title: Manager, Sales Operations & Deal Desk
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

IDMe is the next-generation digital identity wallet that simplifies how individuals securely prove their identity online. Consumers can verify their identity with IDMe once and seamlessly login across websites without having to create a new login and verify their identity again. Over 175 million users experience streamlined login and identity verification with IDMe at 22 federal agencies, 50 state government agencies, and more than 100 healthcare organizations. Over 600 consumer brands use IDMe to verify communities and user segments to honor service and build more authentic relationships. IDMe's technology meets the federal standards for consumer authentication set by the Commerce Department and is approved as a NIST 800-63-3 IAL2 / AAL2 credential service provider by the Kantara Initiative. IDMe is committed to "No Identity Left Behind" to enable all people to have a secure digital identity. To learn more, visit https://network.id.me/.

IDMe is a full-time, in-office culture. Unless a specific job description explicitly states otherwise, all roles are on-site five days per week at one of our offices in McLean, VA; Mountain View, CA; New York City, NY; or Tampa, FL. Certain roles — such as field-based sales or other remote-by-design positions — may have different work arrangements as noted in their individual postings.

At IDMe, we embrace the thoughtful use of AI tools in our daily work and there are even occasions where we leverage AI in our hiring process. However, during the interview process, we want to understand your individual skills and experiences. Therefore, we have guidelines on how AI can be appropriately used during your application and interviews which can be found here.

**About the Role**

ID.me is hiring a Manager of Sales Operations & Deal Desk to be the operational engine behind our sales process — from pipeline hygiene and CRM administration to deal structuring and approvals. This role sits within Revenue Operations and is the day-to-day partner Sales reps and managers turn to for anything that touches process, systems, or deal terms. Given ID.me's consumption-based pricing model, deals often involve non-standard structures — usage tiers, ramp schedules, minimum commitments — that require careful review and consistent governance. This role is a strong fit for someone who's detail-oriented, systems-fluent, and energized by being the person who keeps sales moving efficiently without sacrificing deal quality or compliance.  
Level (Senior Analyst vs. Manager) will be determined based on the candidate's experience.

**Why This Role Matters**

Sales Operations & Deal Desk is where strategy meets execution — every deal that closes efficiently and every clean pipeline report starts here. This role gives you direct, visible impact on how quickly and effectively ID.me's sales team can operate.

**What You'll Do**

Deal Desk

* Review and approve deal structures, pricing exceptions, discounting, and non-standard contract terms in line with company policy
* Partner with Sales, Legal, and Finance to structure deals for ID.me's consumption-based pricing model — usage tiers, minimum commitments, ramp schedules, and renewal terms
* Maintain deal desk approval workflows and playbooks, ensuring consistent turnaround times and clear escalation paths
* Track and report on deal desk cycle time, exception volume, and win/loss patterns tied to deal structure

Sales Operations

* Own CRM data integrity and administration (Salesforce): pipeline hygiene, opportunity stages, fields, and reporting structure
* Support territory design, account assignment, and quota allocation in partnership with Sales leadership
* Build and maintain sales dashboards and reporting for pipeline coverage, forecast accuracy, and rep productivity
* Identify and implement process improvements across the quote-to-cash lifecycle, reducing friction for reps and improving data quality for Finance

Cross-Functional Partnership

* Act as the go-to resource for sales reps and managers on process, systems, and deal questions
* Partner with Finance/FP&A to ensure deal terms and CRM data flow cleanly into revenue reporting and forecasting
* Support onboarding and training for new sales hires on CRM usage, deal desk process, and sales tools
* Assist with ad hoc analysis and projects as Revenue Operations scales

**What You'll Bring**

* 3+ years (Senior Analyst) or 5+ years (Manager) of experience in sales operations, deal desk, or a related analytical function, ideally in B2B SaaS
* Strong hands-on experience with Salesforce (or comparable CRM) — administration, reporting, and workflow configuration
* Strong Excel/spreadsheet skills; comfort building clean, reliable analysis under time pressure
* High attention to detail and a process-oriented mindset — comfortable being the person who enforces consistency
* Clear communicator who can explain policy and process to sales reps without being a bottleneck
* Comfort operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where process is still being built

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with deal structuring for consumption/usage-based pricing models - Experience with CPQ tools or quote-to-cash process design
* Exposure to sales compensation, territory planning, or forecasting

Meta is hiring a Reality Labs Product Data Operations Program Manager to run multilingual data collection (DC) for our language expansion work. Reality Labs builds the next generation of computing across Meta's mixed reality, virtual reality, and wearables products. You'll also build DC practices that can scale and repeat across languages and locales. You'll work across functions with research, engineering, product, quality, legal/privacy, and vendor partners. You'll define and enforce quality standards for data deliverables in a fast-moving environment where priorities shift frequently.

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. jobs.description:
**Assistant Project Manager**

**Onsite – Hayward, CA**

### **Build Something That Makes an Impact.**

At AD/S, we bring ideas to life through custom signage, architectural features, displays, and fixtures that make a lasting impression. From illuminated landmarks that transform city skylines to wayfinding systems that guide people through airports, hospitals, resorts, and other major destinations, our work is seen and experienced every day.

We’re looking for an experienced Assistant Project Manager to join our team and support projects from contract award through final installation. If you thrive on staying organized, coordinating details, building strong customer relationships, solving problems, and keeping teams moving toward a common goal, we want to hear from you.

In this role, you’ll work closely with Project Managers to help drive project execution by coordinating schedules, monitoring budgets, tracking deliverables, and communicating with customers and internal teams. You’ll collaborate with our sales, design, engineering, manufacturing, and installation departments to help ensure projects stay on track, meet expectations, and are completed successfully.

### **What You’ll Do**

* Support Projects from Start to Finish: Assist Project Managers with all phases of assigned projects, including design, permitting, fabrication, delivery, and installation.
* Monitor Budgets and Costs: Work with Project Managers to track project expenses, monitor budgets, review profitability, and help ensure projects stay within allocated funds.
* Keep Teams Aligned: Coordinate schedules, milestones, and deliverables across internal departments, subcontractors, vendors, and customers.
* Build Customer Relationships: Maintain clear and consistent communication with customers, provide project updates, address questions, and help deliver a high level of customer service.
* Coordinate Field Activities: Conduct site visits, monitor project progress, assess site conditions, and work with installation teams to address field-related challenges.
* Interpret Project Documentation: Review and interpret blueprints, construction drawings, specifications, and design packages. Perform take-offs and help ensure project requirements are understood.
* Coordinate Subcontractors: Assist Project Managers with obtaining estimates, negotiating pricing, and coordinating subcontractors for permitting, installation, and related services.
* Monitor Progress: Maintain accurate project records, track milestones, and monitor multiple projects using company software, customized reports, and internal systems.
* Manage Project Updates: Assist with scope changes, change orders, scheduling updates, documentation, and invoicing while helping ensure project costs and deliverables are properly tracked.
* Support Quality and Closeout: Work with internal teams to monitor quality, resolve project issues, and ensure deliverables align with customer expectations and agreed-upon specifications.

### **What You Bring**

* Strong organizational, planning, and customer service skills.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Attention to detail and problem-solving abilities.
* Positive attitude, persistence, and a high level of integrity.
* Ability to work independently while contributing to a team-oriented environment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, and Word.
* Valid driver's license (minimum Class C), satisfactory driving record, and ability to maintain auto insurance coverage.

### **Education/Training/Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent work experience.
* OSHA 30 certification is a plus.
* Five years of relevant professional experience. Sign or construction industry experience required.
* Valid driver's license (minimum Class C), satisfactory driving record, and ability to maintain auto insurance coverage.

### **Perks & Benefits**

We believe great work starts with a great team. AD/S offers:

* Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance.
* Paid vacation, sick time, and holidays.
* 401(k) retirement plan with company matching after the qualifying period.
* Employee referral bonuses and discounts.
* A collaborative environment where craftsmanship, teamwork, and professional growth matter.

### **Why AD/S?**

At AD/S, you won’t just support projects, you’ll help create the signs, structures, and visual experiences that make places recognizable and help people navigate the world around them.

Our success is built on craftsmanship, teamwork, accountability, and integrity. We take pride in what we create, how we work together, and the relationships we build along the way.

If you’re ready to take on new challenges, strengthen your project management skills, and see your work come to life on a larger scale, we invite you to build your next career chapter with AD/S.

**AD/S is an E-Verify Employer. All hires are subject to background checks and drug testing.**

jobs.title: Sr Project Manager
jobs.description:
**At DPR, roles and responsibilities are more than describing a job title—they are a commitment to building great things together. The job description(s) below defines core responsibilities and the scope of the role and is a starting point. Every employee is expected to lead from where they are, take ownership of outcomes, and always act in the best interest of the team, customer, project and organization.**  
  
**As a purpose-driven organization on a journey to be most admired, we rely on trust, shared leadership, open communication, disciplined action and a deep respect for the individual to drive exceptional performance. Success is not just about what we build, but who we build and how we build it: with integrity, enjoyment, uniqueness and an ever-forward mindset.**

**Job Summary:**  
Leads all aspects of project delivery from preconstruction through closeout, ensuring projects meet DPR Construction’s standards for safety, quality, schedule, and financial performance. Oversees project teams and partners with clients, designers, and trade partners to achieve strategic goals and operational excellence. Partners with the Senior Superintendent as a unified project leadership team, sharing responsibility and accountability for project execution, field integration, and overall team performance. Establishes and maintains dependable project controls processes that keeps the team in alignment with the Prime Agreement (schedule, document control, cost management), project success goals and allows for early detection of issues so they can be mitigated. Develops and implements project execution plans, manages risk, and ensures alignment with DPR’s values and best practices. Supports the development of future leaders by mentoring project managers and engineers. Promotes a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement across all project phases.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**  
Oversees the full project lifecycle from business award through final completion, ensuring delivery of scope, budget, schedule, safety, and quality objectives.
  
Manages and directs project teams, including project managers, project engineers, and field operations staff, ensuring alignment with project execution plans and organizational standards, while setting expectations for consistent field presence, reinforcing leadership participation in safety meetings including stretch and flex, and overseeing team fluency and engagement in high-risk activities to drive safe, planned, and controlled outcomes across the project.
  
Builds and maintains relationships with clients, designers, and trade partners to promote collaboration and resolve challenges proactively.
  
Reviews and approves major project decisions, including budgets, contracts, and schedule adjustments, in coordination with project executives and senior leadership.
  
Leads project risk management and mitigation planning, ensuring compliance with DPR’s operational and safety standards.
  
Mentors and develops team members by providing ongoing coaching, delivering structured performance feedback, and guiding individualized development and training plans, strengthening leadership capability and long-term talent growth within DPR’s management framework.
  
Drives continuous improvement initiatives by identifying lessons learned and implementing process enhancements to strengthen project delivery.
  
  
**Education Qualifications:**  
Bachelor’s degree in construction management, engineering, architecture, or a related field, or equivalent experience required.
  
  
**Work Experience:**  
7-10 years of experience in construction project management, including 5 years in a leadership capacity required.
  
Experience managing large, complex commercial, healthcare, life sciences, or advanced technology projects required.
  
  
**Certifications and Licenses:**  
Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) 30-Hour Construction certification preferred. OSHA 30 program completion within 6 months of hire is required.

**Anticipated starting pay range:**

$180,000.00- $200,000.00

***Nothing is more important than your health and wellness. DPR offers a variety of medical, dental, vision and wellness benefits to keep you healthy. Read more about eligibility and available benefits programs***

***for*** skilled craft and labor or experienced professionals and recent graduates .

DPR Construction is a forward-thinking, self-performing general contractor specializing in technically complex and sustainable projects for the advanced technology, life sciences, healthcare, higher education and commercial markets. Founded in 1990, DPR is a great story of entrepreneurial success as a private, employee-owned company that has grown into a multi-billion-dollar family of companies with offices around the world.

Working at DPR, you'll have the chance to try new things, explore unique paths and shape your future. Here, we build opportunity together—by harnessing our talents, enabling curiosity and pursuing our collective ambition to make the best ideas happen. We are proud to be recognized as a great place to work by our talented teammates and leading news organizations like U.S. News and World Report, Forbes, Fast Company and Newsweek.

Explore our open opportunities at www.dpr.com/careers .

jobs.title: Capital Planning and Project Manager I/II (Capital Projects)
jobs.description:
**ABOUT US**
------------

At the County of Marin, our employees overwhelmingly report feeling their work is meaningful, they like the work they do, and they are proud to tell people “I work for the County of Marin.” Discover more about us, our values and our organizational culture on the Department of Human Resources website. Read on to find out more about this opportunity.

The mission of the Marin County Department of Public Works is To provide quality services and maintain and improve public infrastructure and facilities, while protecting Marin’s natural resources. Read more about the Department of Public Works at https://publicworks.marincounty.gov/.

**ABOUT THE POSITION**
----------------------

**Flex recruitment:**  
There are currently three (3) full-time, regular hire Capital Planning and Project Manager I/II (CPPM I/II) vacancies in the Capital Projects Division. Candidates will be considered for the level they meet minimum qualifications.

Working under the direction of the Capital Division Manager and in coordination with senior project management staff, the Capital Planning and Project Manager I and II positions support the delivery of Capital Improvement Projects from the planning and design phases through construction and project closeout. These positions provide project coordination and management support to help ensure projects are delivered safely, efficiently, within approved budgets and schedules, and in accordance with applicable requirements.

The Capital Planning and Project Manager I and II work closely with County project managers, design consultants, contractors, internal departments, and other project stakeholders in the delivery of Capital Projects. Responsibilities include assisting with the development and coordination of Request for Proposals from design consultants and other vendors, documenting design progress meetings, developing contract documents, uploading documents to an online bidding platform and overseeing the contract award process with administrative staff.

These positions help monitor project progress, schedules, budgets, and compliance with state-mandated safety requirements, and work with project team members to identify and address issues that may affect successful project delivery.

This is an excellent opportunity to build a career in capital project management while gaining hands-on experience with planning, coordination, construction, and closeout of projects that make a meaningful difference in the community. Successful candidates will have the opportunity to develop valuable project management skills, work alongside experienced professionals, and take on increasing levels of responsibility as their knowledge and expertise grow.

  
  
**Hybrid schedule:**

The Department of Public Works has embraced a **hybrid work schedule** that considers that some duties of this position may be performed remotely for up to two (2) business days per workweek. However, the successful candidate must be able to report to County facilities for meetings, work assignments, and/or disaster service work upon short notice, as needed and deemed appropriate. During the initial probationary period, the successful candidate may be required to work primarily onsite before establishing a hybrid work schedule.

**Application Timeline:** We look forward to reviewing your application! Please mark your calendar, the filing period for this recruitment will be open from Friday, November 13th, 2026, at 7:00 AM, through the closing date of Monday, November 16th, 2026, at 11:59 PM. You will be able to access the "Apply" function during this time only.

**ABOUT YOU**
-------------

**Our Highly Qualified Candidate:**

  
  

Our ideal CPPM I and II bring 1–3 years of hands-on experience in moderately complex capital and facilities-planning projects, with some experience in design team coordination, bid solicitation, contract award, and progress documentation. The ideal CPPM I and II will have the ability to successfully collaborate across County departments and stakeholder groups through clear, respectful communication.

  
  

Exceptionally organized, they maintain precise project documentation and distill technical and financial details into concise reports for leadership and public audiences. A resourceful problem-solver, they anticipate site-level challenges and implement compliant, cost-effective solutions, taking ownership from kickoff through closeout while adapting seamlessly between remote and onsite work.

Above all, they share our commitment to stewardship, integrity, and continuous improvement, delivering public facilities that truly serve the community.

  
  
**QUALIFICATIONS**  
  
  

**Capital Planning and Project Manager I**

**Knowledge of:**

* Construction principles and practices including materials, methods, and tools involved in repair and construction of buildings, structures, and infrastructure.

* Federal, state, and local codes, statutes, and regulations pertaining to public sector construction projects and contract and labor compliance.

* Principles and practices of project management and evaluation.

* Cost estimating and cost control techniques.

* Public safety and security including relevant equipment, policies, procedures, and strategies to promote effective local and state security operations for the protection of people, property, and data.

* Government purchasing and bidding policies, practices, and procedures.

* Professional services contracting.

* Computer technology, including project management systems and software.

* Disability access compliance and related Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) laws.

* Sustainable Green building principles and practices.

* Real estate, including principles and practices of effective commercial property management.

* Budget development and tracking, cost control procedures, financial forecasting, and fiscal analysis.

* Space and furniture planning.

* Project planning including plan develo

In this role, you will define the strategic framework for how Meta's systems, APIs, and third-party integrations are operationalized, ensuring seamless interoperability across product lines. You will drive alignment across engineering, product, legal, and business development teams to deliver integration programs that are reliable, scalable, and positioned to support Meta's long-term platform ambitions.  
  
  

### **Integrations Program Manager Responsibilities:**

* Define and own the end-to-end program strategy for large-scale platform and product integrations, including API partnerships, third-party ecosystem onboarding, and cross-product interoperability initiatives
* Establish governance frameworks, integration standards, and operational playbooks that scale across multiple product lines and partner tiers
* Lead cross-functional alignment across Engineering, Product, Legal, Privacy, Business Development, and Operations to resolve integration blockers and drive program milestones
* Identify systemic risks and dependencies across integration portfolios and develop mitigation strategies that protect platform reliability and partner experience
* Define and track program health metrics, integration SLAs, and partner adoption KPIs, translating data into executive-level insights and strategic recommendations
* Drive organizational change by influencing integration architecture decisions and advocating for scalable, reusable integration patterns across teams
* Partner with product leads to evaluate technical feasibility of integration approaches and translate business requirements into actionable operational designs
* Build and maintain relationships with internal platform teams and external partners to anticipate integration needs and proactively shape roadmap priorities
* Lead post-launch integration reviews, identify operational gaps, and implement continuous improvement processes to increase integration reliability and partner satisfaction
* Mentor other program managers on integration program methodology, stakeholder management, and cross-functional execution best practices

* 8+ years of experience in technical program management, integrity or support operations, or integration management within a technology company
