jobs.title: Case Manager II
jobs.description:
**JOB SUMMARY**: The Case Manager II (CM II), a key member of the primary care interdisciplinary team, provides services for patients with complex care needs. This position conducts patient outreach, engagement and psychosocial service assessment, assists in developing a patient-centered care plan, is the lead implementer of Enhanced Care Management (ECM) and coordinates service referrals and delivery. The Case Manager meets clients in home, clinic, or community as appropriate or required by the specific program/site. The CM II provides services to specific populations that have multiple complex health and social services needs and often provides care outside of a traditional health center setting, such as home visits, hospitals, supportive housing sites, encampments and shelters.

This position is represented by SEIU-UHW. Salaries and benefits are set by a collective bargaining agreement (CBA), and an employee in this position must remain a member in good standing of SEIU-UHW, as defined in the CBA.

**Essential Functions**:

* Outreach, via telephone and in person at LifeLong, community and residential sites, to patients who meet case management program eligibility criteria or are prioritized by LifeLong for this service
* Proactively meet and engage with patients to build effective relationships and assess strengths and needs through use of standard intake, screening tools, and health, and social services records review
* Actively involve patients and caregivers, as appropriate, in designing and delivering services, including development of care plans, assuring alignment with patients’ values and expressed goals of care
* Provide and facilitate referrals for internal and external resources, and collaborate with the patient to complete required applications, forms, or releases of information
* Maintain a patient caseload in accordance with LifeLong standards for the specific population served or site requirements
* Utilize data registries and reports to manage caseload, meet program requirements, maintain grant deliverables, and promote high quality care
* Provide health education and training to patients, including but not limited to, harm reduction and disease risk-mitigation strategies that empower patients to manage their own health and wellness (e.g. overdose prevention, mitigating spread of communicable diseases)
* Assist patients with accessing and retaining public benefits and insurance (e.g. MediCal, SSI/SSDI, CalFresh, General Assistance, etc), and affordable/subsidized housing
* Respectfully and routinely communicate with patients, their care team members, external partners, and identified social supports
* Maintain knowledge of patients’ medical/behavioral health treatment plans and facilitate utilization of services by providing resources such as accompaniment, transportation, in-home care, reminder calls etc.
* Participate in team meetings to coordinate care, support patient goals, and reduce barriers to accessing services
* Advocate on behalf of patients to get their needs met and/or support patients to learn advocacy strategies for themselves.
* Provide case management services to patients with multiple complex acute or chronic medical or behavioral health conditions (e.g. HIV/AIDS, Hep C, congestive heart failure, severe diabetes, severe hypertension, psychosis, pregnancy, and homelessness)
* Provide general housing case management services that includes document readiness, housing problem solving, and assessments for Coordinated Entry System
* Assist with patient crisis intervention and de-escalation
* Provide and document billable services to eligible populations that result in revenue generation for LifeLong
* Keep current on community resources and social service supports to effectively serve the target population
* Document patient contacts/services in required data systems (EHR, HMIS etc.) according to LifeLong policy
* Specific activities may vary depending on the requirements of the program and funder.
* Promote diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in support of patients and staff
* Represent LifeLong positively in the community and advocate on behalf of underserved populations

**Qualifications**

* Commitment to working directly with low-income persons from diverse backgrounds in a culturally responsive manner
* Commitment to harm reduction, recovery, housing first, age-friendly and patient centered care
* Strong organizational, administrative and problem-solving skills, and ability to be flexible and adaptive to change while maintaining a positive attitude
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written skills
* Ability to prioritize tasks, work under pressure, and complete assignments in a timely manner
* Ability to seek direction/approval on essential matters, yet work independently, using professional judgment and diplomacy
* Works well in a team-oriented environment
* Conducts oneself in external settings in a way that reflects positively on your employer
* Ability to be creative, mature, proactive, and committed to continual learning and improvement in professional settings

**Job Requirements**

* High School diploma or GED
* At least two (2) years of progressively responsible work or volunteer experience in a community-based health care or social work setting or at least one (1) year of experience as a Case Manager I or equivalent position
* Proficient skills using Microsoft Office applications like Word, Excel, and Outlook, as well as the ability to work in and/or manage databases
* Access to reliable transportation with current license and insurance

**Job Preferences**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Social Work, or another Health or Human Services field
* Work or lived experience in area(s) relevant to the population to be served: e.g. perinatal, homelessness, recovery, criminal justice, elder care, palliative and end-of-life care, or behavioral health

Supervises clinic operations, typically spanning multiple providers, clinics and/or practices. Subordinates include staff involved with professional operational functions. Oversight of administrative areas such as practice revenue management, billing systems and procedures, facilities and safety procedures, registration, new patient coordination, scheduling, medical records storage and maintenance, insurance authorizations. jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

Overhaul is a supply chain integrity solutions company that allows shippers to connect disparate sources of data into the first fully transparent situational analysis engine designed for the logistics industry. Data that is transformed into critical insights can instantly trigger corrective actions, impacting everything from temperature control to handling requirements or package-level tracking, ensuring cargo arrives at its destination safely, undamaged, and on time. We are a dynamic, innovative, and fun team who is highly committed to our customers’ experiences and our Mission and Vision.

**The Role**  
  
As a Strategic Account Manager based in San Jose, you own a portfolio of Overhaul’s strategic enterprise accounts, accelerating growth by highlighting Overhaul’s Enterprise business solutions that greatly increase supply chain visibility, integrity, and security. Most of your accounts will be based in or near Silicon Valley, though your portfolio may also include accounts headquartered elsewhere. Through your expertise and understanding of each client’s needs, you outline uniquely beneficial combinations of our software and services solutions that deliver on customer and business goals while creating demand for the future.

You are enthusiastic about our service suite and inspiring clients to share in your enthusiasm while retaining current service and expanding future value from Overhaul’s suite of services. You have developed a keen ability for identifying roadblocks and overcoming obstacles to increase business and enhance the client experience. You flourish in a fast-paced environment and are energized by being on the ground with your accounts — this role involves regular on-site presence at client offices throughout the Bay Area, working in person with the teams you support.

**Strategic Account Manager** **Responsibilities:**

* Retain customer relationships, while growing the Overhaul service suite within the assigned customer base.
* Interacting with C-Level and VP-Level Executives, driving the digital transformation strategy for assigned account base.
* Maintain existing customer relationships and satisfaction, while gaining new customer contacts for Overhaul services. Create cross-department relationships and value in the customer base.
* Manage the pricing, negotiation, and execution of client contract renewals and expansion.
* While selling existing solutions, work within the business to advocate for solving additional customer challenges, resulting in revenue quota attainment.
* Working with operations, marketing, product, engineering, and data science departments to align future client needs with product and services roadmap.
* Coordinate and partner with Customer Success Management (CSM) team members for strategic business reviews with clients to guide vision and execution of expanded Overhaul services.
* Ability to navigate the customer and the business to reach revenue goals.
* Maintain a regular on-site presence for your Silicon Valley-based accounts — for example, splitting your week across one or more client offices in the Bay Area — while managing any accounts based outside the region remotely or through periodic travel, depending on account assignment.

**About you:**

* Demonstrable history of achieving company revenue goals and growth while enabling a long-term customer relationship
* Capable of thriving in fast-paced Start-Up environment
* 5+ years’ experience in enterprise revenue generating or account management role
* Previous management of Fortune 1000 accounts
* Based in or willing to relocate to the San Jose / Silicon Valley area, with the flexibility to work on-site at multiple client offices across the Bay Area each week
* Previous supply chain management, logistics, law enforcement, and/or cargo security experience
* Ability to travel regionally between client offices across the Bay Area, and further domestically or internationally as needed for accounts based outside the region.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
  + This role will communicate within all paygrades at the customer base and within Overhaul. This is from dock worker to senior executive level.

* Excellent analytical and communication skills with strong business acumen and intuition
* Self-motivated – possess a strong desire to be successful and self-directed
* Passion for fast-paced, high-growth and challenging environments
* Experience navigating a complex, global customers across all departments: Logistics, Operations, Security, Cyber Security, etc.

jobs.title: Global Account Manager, FSI
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

The Account Engineer is a high-impact, cross-functional role designed to accelerate the customer journey from initial acquisition to successful platform adoption and expansion on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud. You will contribute to this mission by driving initial utilization, leveraging modern AI-powered tools and coding agents to ensure technical success.

This role bridges the critical gap by helping new and early-stage customers achieve rapid implementation, quick value, and a world-class experience on the Snowflake platform. You will be the dedicated customer technical partner, responsible for driving technical enablement and supporting the overall activation and adoption of our customers initial use cases.

This is a fantastic opportunity for technical professionals to develop deep expertise in cloud data architecture, make a measurable impact on customer success, and contribute to one of the fastest-growing technology companies.

Location: Candidate must be based in or near Seattle or Menlo Park.

**Key Responsibilities and Deliverables**

* The Account Engineer manages a critical portfolio of new and early-stage customers, and is accountable for accelerating their time-to-value and achieving sustained platform growth. Operating as a Full-Stack Technical Resource, this role blends deep hands-on expertise with the strategic acumen of a business leader.
* Strategic Ownership and Value Creation
* Lead Your Account Micro-Business: Take ownership of the technical success and consumption trajectory within your assigned portfolio, driving adoption metrics in your assigned accounts, acting as a single point of contact for all customer needs.
* Driving Outcome-Based Utilization: Apply an outcome-based selling mindset to customer engagements, focusing on how the Snowflake AI Data Cloud helps them solve complex data challenges and unlock maximum business value—not just product features.
* Strategic Advisory and Guidance: Serve as a trusted strategic advisor immediately following the initial contract close, providing guidance on data strategy, technology stack integration, and ensuring a swift, successful activation of Use Cases.
* Deliver Technical Value with AI: Deliver technical value efficiently by leveraging cutting-edge AI-powered development tools and automation to accelerate solutions and implementation guidance, helping customers move faster to production.

* Architectural Leadership: Provide customers with critical, Snowflake-specific foundational guidance, including Architectural Best Practices, Workload Isolation & Warehouse Utilization, Resource Monitoring & Alerts, Budgeting, and RBAC/Security Setup.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate effectively with the Account Team to highlight risks and establish and nurture trusted relationships with internal Snowflake teams (e.g., Professional Services, Support) and external partners to ensure seamless resource orchestration.
* Develop Scalable Programs: Create and deliver reusable, high-impact programs, such as Hands-on Labs (HoLs) and webinars, to educate a wide customer audience on specific platform features and industry best practices.
* Technical Feedback Loop & Innovation: Act as a key feedback loop from the field to influence future product development, working closely with Product Management and Engineering teams.
* Expert Support and Triage: Efficiently triage a broad array of incoming customer inquiries, assisting the field team with demos, troubleshooting, and identifying opportunities to qualify potential business value for the Expansion team.

**Required Qualifications**

* We are seeking highly skilled and motivated technical professionals eager to launch their next career chapter with us.
* Technical Aptitude: Hands-on experience with SQL is required.
* Data & Cloud Knowledge: Strong foundational understanding and experience with data architecture, data analytics, and the core concepts of major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
* Growth Mindset: A strong desire to learn, grow your technical skills, and become an expert in the Snowflake platform.
* Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and effectively to diverse audiences.
* Professional Skills: Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously and possess Project Management skills to track, manage, and drive customers to an agreed-upon timeline.
* Education: University degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or related fields, or equivalent practical experience in a technical role.
* What Sets You Apart (Preferred Qualifications)
* SnowPro Core certification.
* Proficiency in additional coding languages, particularly Python, Java, or Scala, especially in a data or application development context.
* Experience with modern data technologies (e.g., CI/CD tooling, orchestration tools) or a basic understanding of Data Science concepts.
* Prior experience or strong interest in leveraging AI-powered development tools and coding agents to increase solution delivery efficiency.

**Performance Assessment & Career Path**

* This role is designed as a direct path to a successful career within the Snowflake Solution Engineering org

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

* Motivated with a passion for organization and administration

***Note on Fraudulent Recruiting***

*We have become aware that there may be fraudulent recruiting attempts being made by people posing as representatives of ERGO NEXT Insurance. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers.*  
  
*Please note, we do not ask for sensitive information via chat, text, or social media, and any email communications will come from the domain @next-insurance.com or @**nextinsurance.com**. Additionally, Next Insurance will never ask for payment, fees, or purchases to be made by a job applicant. All applicants are encouraged to apply directly to our open jobs via the careers page on our website. Interviews are generally conducted via Zoom video conference unless the candidate requests other accommodations.*

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. Goaly is an early-stage AI startup founded by ex-Meta Superintelligence Labs engineers and researchers who built the Llama Research Platform and led post-training efficiency on Meta's Superintelligence team. Goaly is the autonomous performance layer for AI training: it watches every job across a GPU fleet, catches the runs that are wasting compute, and shows teams what each model improvement actually costs.

Backed by leading AI investors, we're looking for the person who makes our Palo Alto office run: the one who notices what's missing before anyone else does and fixes it the same day.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**
------------------

You will be our first Office Manager and you will own the office end to end. Our team works in person, and the office has to work every day: stocked, fed, clean, secure, and ready for whoever walks in, whether that's a new hire, a candidate in for an onsite, or a visiting customer.

The job is three things: keep the office running (supplies, food, facilities, vendors, budget, mail); make first days and visits great (onboarding, candidate and guest hospitality, on-site events); and be the operational backbone for a small team (light scheduling, travel, and expense support for the founders and business team).

You report to the Head of Business & Operations and work daily with the founders, engineering, and the go-to-market team. There is no office playbook yet; you write it.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**
------------------

**Run the office**

* Own office supplies: track inventory and reorder before anything runs out.
* Run the meals program: extra order of lunch and dinner, snacks and drinks, dietary needs, and the budget. Food is a core perk here and it never slips.
* Keep the kitchen and common areas clean, stocked, and working.
* Be the point of contact for building and property management: badges and keys, HVAC, cleaning, repairs, parking, and weekend access.
* Handle mail, packages, and shipping and receiving, including hardware and employee equipment.
* Keep the layout working as we grow: desks, seating, furniture. When the time comes, lead the next office search, build-out, and move.

**Keep it safe and secure**

* Own access control: badges issued and revoked on first and last days, visitor sign-in, and a monthly review of who has access.
* Keep first-aid kits, evacuation materials, and emergency contacts current, and schedule drills with the building.
* Be first point of contact for minor incidents and facility problems; escalate the rest.

**Welcome new hires, candidates, and guests**

* Host candidate onsites: greet, keep the day on schedule, rooms and interviewers ready, meals and travel reimbursement handled.
* Be the front door for visitors and customers, with conference rooms set up and working.

**Support the founders and business team**

* Calendars, scheduling, and travel; receipts, expenses, and vendor invoices with our finance partner.
* Swag program and ad hoc projects: printing, notarizations, errands, bank and government paperwork.

**Write the playbook**

* Stand up one place for office requests with a response standard the team can count on.
* Document how the office runs (vendors, ordering, onboarding, visitors, emergencies) so someone else could keep the lights on if you were out for a week.
* Keep a simple view of spend, vendors, inventory, and recurring requests. Fix what repeats.

**YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU HAVE**
-------------------------------------

**Minimum**

* 2+ years running a physical space and the people in it: office manager, workplace or facilities coordinator, executive assistant, or a front-of-house or hospitality role with real operational scope. Startup experience is a plus, not a requirement.
* Strong organization and follow-through: you keep lists, close loops, and nothing you own runs out.
* Warm and professional with everyone, from founders and customers to candidates and delivery drivers.
* Comfort with Google Workspace, Slack, spreadsheets, and vendor portals, and fluent with AI tools (Claude or similar) for drafting, research, and tracking.
* Discretion with confidential information, and a self-starter who fixes what is missing without being asked.
* Able to work five days a week in our Palo Alto office and to be the first one in most mornings.

**Preferred**

* **Big bonus:** prior office management or operations experience at an AI company or AI lab.
* Only person doing this job at an early-stage startup (under 50 people).
* New-hire onboarding, IT equipment setup, recruiting coordination, or executive support.
* Event logistics, or an office move, build-out, or space planning.
* Access control and visitor management systems; SOC 2 or similar compliance records.
* First Aid and CPR, or a notary commission, or willingness to get either.

**REASONS NOT TO TAKE THIS JOB**
--------------------------------

* You want a hybrid or remote job. This one is in the office every day, because the work is in the office.
* You want a defined scope. Here it is "whatever the office and the team need," and it changes week to week.
* You would rather manage coordinators than order the lunch, sign for the package, and set up the monitor yourself.

----------------------------

jobs.description:
### Position Title: Community Health Navigator II

**Department**: Operations

**Reports To**: ECM Territory Manager

**Location**: Hybrid/ Remote

**Employment Type**: Full-time

**Travel requirement:** This is a field-based position and requires substantial travel to meet with members where they live.

**About MedZed**
----------------

MedZed is a leader in delivering value-based, technology-enabled social support to a diverse population of high-cost Medicaid members who have been unreachable with telephonic outreach, disconnected from primary care, and using hospital-based services as their primary point of care. We combine innovative technologies with field-based outreach to find and engage these members. We then apply a model of care designed to re-connect them to primary care, address the Health-Related Social Needs (HRSNs) that contribute to their disengagement and present barriers to care, and provide them with the means and knowledge to take more control over their healthcare. Our interventions yield reduced Emergency Department and Inpatient utilization costs for our health plan partners and improved quality of life for their members.

### **Primary Focus:**

Independent field-based case management for moderate-to-high acuity members. To be effective, associates in this position will spend a substantial part of the work week visiting and enrolling members in the community.

**Position Overview:**
----------------------

**The Community Health Navigator II (CHN II) is an ECM care manager responsible for managing complex and high-acuity member cases, serving as a mentor to newly hired care team staff, and modeling excellence in engagement, documentation, and compliance performance. The CHN II role is focused on developing foundational care coordination skills. CHN IIs are responsible for outreach (via door knocks and telephone), assessments, quality and billable care delivery and member graduations in compliance with CalAIM, DHCS, and contracted health plan requirements.** **This role is non-clinical in nature and is an in-field position minimum 4 days a week.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------

* Manage an ECM caseload up to 50+ members.
* Complete initial and follow-up ECM assessments including Primary, Secondary, PHQ-9, and required reassessments.
* Support development and updates of individualized Care Plans
* Calls, field visits, and door knock to provide care and enroll new members.
* Build and maintain a member panel through consistent outreach.
* Coordinate referrals to health plans, providers, and community-based resources.
* Staff tables and other community partnership opportunities as requested.
* Document timely, accurate, and compliant case notes in Salesforce Health Cloud and health plan portals, as necessary.
* Participate in interdisciplinary case conferences and team huddles
* Escalate complex or high-risk member needs appropriately.
* Maintain compliance with CalAIM, DHCS, and health plan requirements.
* Meet outreach, engagement, and documentation standards.
* Attend required training and professional development.
* Support audit readiness and data tracking activities.
* Comply with all company policies and administrative requirements

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

* High School Diploma or equivalent required
* 2+ years’ experience in ECM, case management, or community health
* Demonstrated excellence in documentation and compliance.
* Ability to manage complex psychosocial and medical needs.
* Curious and relentless nature
* Commitment to do outreach via phone and in-person to enroll new members.

**Internal Promotion Criteria (CHN II CHN III):**

* Serve as a CHN II for a minimum of 12 months.
* Maintain engagement, outreach, panel size, and quality metrics for at least six consecutive months.
* Be in good standing with no active corrective action.

jobs.title: Case Manager I, Health Systems Navigation
jobs.description:
**About Glide**

GLIDE is a nationally recognized center for social justice, dedicated to fighting systemic injustices, creating pathways out of poverty and crisis, and transforming lives. Through its integrated comprehensive services, advocacy initiatives, and inclusive community, GLIDE empowers individuals, families, and children to achieve stability and to thrive. GLIDE is on the forefront of addressing some of society’s most pressing issues, including poverty, housing and homelessness, and racial and social justice. GLIDE’s mission is to create a radically inclusive, just, and loving community mobilized to alleviate suffering and break the cycles of poverty and marginalization

**Position Summary:**

The Health Systems Navigation (HSN) Case Manager provides comprehensive, client-centered case management with a harm reduction focus to individuals who use substances. This role facilitates seamless access to and retention in a full spectrum of health services, including primary care, behavioral health, substance use treatment, and HIV/HCV/STI prevention and care. Responsibilities include conducting outreach, testing, counseling, and support groups, with a primary focus on re-engaging participants who are newly diagnosed or have fallen out of care. By managing a dedicated caseload and developing individualized care plans that prioritize client-identified goals (such as improving health, securing housing, and accessing social services), the Case Manager supports participants on their journey toward improved health, stability, and self-sufficiency.

### **Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Conduct client intakes and assessments to identify strengths, needs, and barriers to care.
* Develop, implement, and update individualized care plans in collaboration with clients to achieve their health, housing, income, and stability goals.
* Provide ongoing, strengths-based case management and consistent follow-up to a dedicated caseload to support progress toward care plan objectives.
* Coordinate internal and external services, including medical care, behavioral health, substance use treatment, and housing, and assist clients in obtaining vital documentation and public benefits.
* Provide confidential HIV/HCV/STI risk reduction counseling, and risk assessment and disclosure sessions using evidence-based approaches to people seeking confidential HIV/HCV/STI testing.
* Build a positive rapport with clients through the compassionate and non-judgmental application of harm reduction and trauma-informed principles.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for linkage-to-care referrals for clients who test positive for HIV/HCV/STI, ensuring a warm handoff and supportive follow-up.
* Facilitate harm reduction and health education support groups on a regular basis.
* Conduct targeted outreach and engagement in various community settings, including SROs, shelters, and via GLIDE's mobile testing team, to identify and connect with clients across SF.
* Represent GLIDE at community events, health fairs, and partner meetings to promote program services and collaborative care.
* Maintain accurate, timely, and confidential client records and case documentation in compliance with HIPAA and program standards.
* Complete all required data entry in designated databases (e.g., Salesforce) to capture contract deliverables and support reporting.
* Actively participate in care coordination meetings with internal and external partners to ensure integrated service delivery.
* Engage in regular supervision, team meetings, and professional development training.
* Prepare and submit monthly activity and data reports to capture program deliverables.
* Serve as the primary contact for linkage-to-care referrals for clients testing positive for HIV/HCV/STI, ensuring warm handoffs.
* Adhere to professional boundaries, ethical standards, and HIPAA protocols.
* Develop and prepare culturally appropriate outreach and educational materials to promote program services.
* Support and participate in the full range of HEAT program services and special events.
* Conduct consistent follow-ups (e.g., office, outreach, phone) to support client goals and document progress.

### **Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in social work, public health or related field and/or 2+ years providing harm reduction focused case management services to high-risk populations, including knowledge providing prescriptions for suboxone, naltrexone and other medications (and methadone dispensaries) used to support treatment adherence for clients who access HEAT MOUD services.
* Must have extensive knowledge of the prevention and treatment of HCV, HIV, and STIs.
* Ability to plan and implement outreach objectives in alignment with HEAT program needs and to promote HEAT program objectives.
* Ability to establish and maintain effective collaborative relationships across GLIDE programs, city agencies, and community partners across San Francisco and the wider Bay Are
* Understanding of core principles and practices of harm reduction and successfully engage clients in services and retention through the application of risk reduction counseling, strengths-based counseling techniques and trauma informed systems of care.
* Knowledge of the Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) and ability to provide culturally competent, culturally sensitive support to a diverse community of clients to help them achieve stability and self-sufficiency.
* Strong communication skills and trust-building skills are required, including comfort and proficiency with public speaking (i.e. 1:1 interaction with clients, group education, street outreach, etc.)
* Experience and training in overdose reversals, de-escalation techniques, motivational interviewing, and other relevant skills in managing chaotic environments

### **Certificates, Licenses**

* California Rapid HIV/HCV/STI test counselor certification preferred OR willingness to be trained.
* Current California driver’s license pref

jobs.description:

If you're ready to be part of our legacy of hope and innovation, we encourage you to take the first step and explore our current job openings. Your best is waiting to be discovered.

  
Day - 08 Hour (United States of America)**This is a Stanford Health Care job.**  
  
**A Brief Overview**  
The Patient Care Manager is a Registered Nurse who provides unit leadership and works in partnership with nursing, the healthcare team, hospital/system leaders to develop a quality practice setting that support professional nursing and quality patient care. The Patient Care Manager is accountable for the effective delivery of competent, compassionate, and efficient patient care. Responsibilities include coordination of patient care; supervision of a professional team that includes multiple nursing and other staff as appropriate; administrative and budget management; troubleshooting of problem areas; organizational change management; ensuring compliance with accreditation and regulatory standards; quality assurance/quality improvement; safety and risk management requirements as well as actualization of hospital and unit policies, goals and objectives. Further, improving unit operations, enhancing communication and feedback, customizing education and staff roles, and accepting organizational accountability for services provided to recipients are critical outcomes expected of this role. The Patient Care Manager role is critical to hospital operations and minimally accomplishes the following essential duties. Patient Care Manager I vs. II designation is based on span of control, hours of operation, and level of unit complexity.
  
  
**Locations**  
Stanford Health Care  
  
**What you will do**

* Clinical Practice: Ensures the effective delivery of competent, compassionate, and efficient patient care by planning, organizing, and directing the nursing services of unit(s), including the assessment of patients, implementation of physicians' orders, treatment plans and medical procedures, administration of medication and record keeping of same as well as by monitoring and evaluating patient care processes and outcomes for the patient care unit(s); coordinates nursing activities with those of other services or disciplines. Demonstrates clinical competency in assigned specialty area role models nursing practice consistent with the organizational and department mission, vision and values.
* Communication: Communicates in a clear and effective manner to enhance team effectiveness, manage conflicts, engage employees and interdisciplinary colleagues in unit activities and performance changes. Collaborates with others within the unit and with all hospital departments and disciplines to enhance problem solving, decision making and performance improvement.
* Fiscal Accountability: Plans and forecasts the department budget by calculating required FTES, planning annual budgets, interpreting payroll and other key fiscal reports, projecting workload as well as monitoring and enhancing productivity. Performs variance analysis by interpreting financial performance and identifying key drivers. Identifies unit/capital budget needs in collaboration with physician and nursing colleagues. Plans and implements staff scheduling, position controls and attendance control procedures.
* Human Resources: Directs the personnel management of the employees assigned to the department consistent with state and federal labor laws, collective bargaining agreements, and nursing service and hospital philosophy, goals and policy. Ensures that new staff is interviewed, hired, trained, oriented, precepted and evaluated. Prepares and conducts employee performance appraisals. Approves transfers, promotions and other decisions affecting employee pay and status. Participates in initiating and documenting disciplinary actions and responding to grievances.
* Leadership: Assumes twenty four (24) hour responsibility and accountability for the operation of the assigned patient care unit(s), service(s), staff, and facilities. Plans, organizes and directs short and long term departmental activities in accordance with hospital goals and accrediting organization standards. Provides leadership and direction for the staff in the patient care unit(s) while supporting and actualizing the goals of the department, division, service, and hospital. Functions as a resource to staff and interdisciplinary team members and interdepartmentally, consults on nursing care and professional nursing practice.
* Performance Improvement: Assumes responsibility for accessing and utilizing appropriate date in order to monitor unit operations. Accountable for achieving patient and staff satisfaction targets for the organization and unit of responsibility. Develops, implements and evaluates process improvement projects/process in order to continually monitor and improve patient care.
* Professional Development: Facilitates professional development and clinical growth of nursing staff through implementation and maintenance of unit specific competencies. Promotes and facilitates educational opportunities based on assessment of staff needs.
* Quality Management: Supports the quality framework, which includes both clinical and service quality indicators. Creates an environment of patient care that is safe, effective, patient centered, timely, efficient and equitable.

  
**Education Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Nursing or Related field from an accredited college or university

  
**Experience Qualifications**

* Three years of progressively responsible and directly related work experience Required

Description:

### **Position Summary:**

The Training Specialist I is responsible for delivering high-impact, equity-driven training within the organization and with external partners to support Roots’ mission of uplifting and empowering high-priority, marginalized communities. Operating under the supervision of the Roots Training Manager, this role focuses on preparing, facilitating, and evaluating comprehensive training programs. This includes supporting the delivery of foundational classroom curriculum for the Community Health Worker (CHW) program, assisting with administering standard Workforce Development training, and facilitating sessions for specialized certifications like Adult Mental Health First Aid. By collaborating with subject matter experts and program managers, the Training Specialist I ensures all staff, trainees, and partners are equipped with the pedagogical, clinical, and interpersonal competencies required to mitigate social determinants of health (SDOH).

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* **Training Delivery & Facilitation:** Conduct dynamic, interactive training sessions using diverse instructional methodologies that emphasize repetition, peer-to-peer modules, and active student "teach-backs".
* **CHW Curriculum Execution:** Facilitate the 45-to-48-hour classroom training footprint across core instructional dimensions, including client engagement, behavioral health, trauma-informed care, and toxic stress analysis.
* **Universal Training Administration:** Lead the execution of Roots Universal Training modules required for organizational onboarding:
  + *Roots History:* Anchoring new employee hires in the organization's mission, values, and community rituals.
  + *Epidemiology:* Introducing localized health disparities and health literacy trends within target zones like East Oakland.
  + *Interpersonal/Professional Skills:* Delivering the Professionalism Suite to cultivate workplace success, boundary setting, and compliance standards.
* **Mental Health First Aid Integration:** Conduct protocol-driven training and certifications in Adult Mental Health First Aid to prepare participants to respond to acute psychiatric and substance use crises.
* **Workforce Development Support:** Support specialized workforce initiatives to transition staff and community members into sustainable healthcare careers, reinforcing the CHW track as a lifelong professional path.
* **Collaborative Design & Adaptability:** Partner with subject matter experts to adapt instructional content to align with the Community Health Worker national standard frameworks.
* **MAA & Regulatory Literacy Integration:** Incorporate knowledge of Medi-Cal Administrative Activities (MAA) billing, state Medi-Cal eligibility navigation, complex care management, and mandatory reporting laws into routine instruction.
* **Impact Evaluation & Record Keeping:** Assist in evaluating training efficacy through mock office simulations and structured assessments, maintaining precise tracking systems for trainee participation, hours credit, and completion records.
* **Administrative Support:** Attend department and staff meetings as necessary to align instruction with broader Learning standard operating procedures.

Requirements:

### **Core Competencies:**

* **Presentation & Communication:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills; demonstrated ability to guide group discussions, manage professional environments, and lead community rituals.
* **Clinical/Community Framework Experience:** Proven experience implementing training within a clinical setting, healthcare navigation network, or community health framework.
* **Technical & Regulatory Proficiency:** Comfort utilizing e-learning platforms, digital tools, and electronic medical records navigation systems, while preserving critical ethical standards such as HIPAA and the ADA.
* **Project Management & Collaboration:** Strong organizational skills with a proven ability to manage multiple training cohorts, deadlines, and pre-designed curricula simultaneously.
* **Cultural Humility & Adaptability:** Ability to pivot delivery based on stakeholder needs, maintaining a firm commitment to empowering communities of African and Indigenous descent.

Calix is a cloud and software platform company focused on enabling broadband service providers of all sizes to simplify operations, excite subscribers, and grow value. Our mission is to connect everyone and everything by building the cloud and software platforms, systems, and services required to deliver the ultimate subscriber experience.  
  
At Calix, purpose runs deep. You will join a collaborative, fast-moving environment where innovation meets execution, and where your work helps broadband service providers transform their businesses.

This position resides within the Commercial Strategy, Revenue Operations organization and reports directly to the Senior Manager, Partner Operations. As a Partner Operations Manager, you will support the Channel & Ecosystem Partners & Government Affairs & Industry Associations team by driving the operational execution of partner programs, processes, systems, and business initiatives.

You will work closely with Partner Leadership and cross-functional teams to improve program effectiveness, streamline operations, deliver actionable insights, and help scale the Calix partner ecosystem. The ideal candidate combines operational rigor, analytical skills, and program management expertise with experience working with channel partners and managed service providers.

**A Typical Day in Partner Operations Includes**
================================================

* Support the operational execution and ongoing management of Channel & Ecosystem Partner programs.
* Develop, document, and improve processes, workflows, and playbooks that drive partner program effectiveness.
* Manage program activities, communications, reporting, and stakeholder coordination across the partner organization.
* Deliver recurring business insights, dashboards, and analysis to support operational and strategic decision-making.
* Partner with Commercial Operations, Finance, Marketing, Compensation, Sales, and other cross-functional teams to execute partner initiatives.
* Track program performance, identify trends, and recommend process improvements that increase efficiency and scale.
* Support partner onboarding, incentives, enablement, and engagement programs as required.
* Manage operational aspects of partner projects from planning through execution.
* Conduct root-cause analysis of business and program performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Ensure consistency, compliance, and adoption of partner program policies, processes, and tools.
* Support annual planning activities, program launches, and ongoing operational initiatives.
* Perform ad hoc reporting, analysis, and special projects as assigned.

The base pay range for this position varies based on the geographic location. More information about the pay range specific to candidate location and other factors will be shared during the recruitment process. Individual pay is determined based on location of residence and multiple factors, including job-related knowledge, skills and experience.

**San Francisco Bay Area****:**

133,400 - 200,100 USD Annual

**Select US Metros and States:**

116,000 - 174,000 USD Annual

**Other US Locations****:**

104,400 - 156,600 USD Annual

As a part of the total compensation package, this role may be eligible for a bonus. For information on our benefits click here.

  

### **About Us**

**PLEASE NOTE:** All emails from Calix will come from a '@calix.com' email address. Please verify and confirm any communication from Calix prior to disclosing any personal or financial information. If you receive a communication that you think may not be from Calix, please report it to us at talentandculture@calix.com.

The Calix platform enables Communication Service Providers (CSPs) of all sizes to transform and future-proof their businesses. Through real-time data, automation, and actionable insights delivered via Calix One — our cloud-first, AI-powered platform — CSPs can simplify operations, collapse cost, and accelerate innovation. Calix One brings together the automation of everything and the experience of one, empowering customers to deliver differentiated subscriber experiences while driving acquisition, loyalty, and revenue growth. This is the Calix mission: to enable CSPs of all sizes to simplify, innovate, and grow, strengthening both their businesses and the communities they serve.

We’re at the forefront of a once‑in‑a‑generation change in the broadband industry. Join us as we innovate, help our customers reach their potential, and connect underserved communities with unrivaled digital experiences.

If you are a person with a disability needing assistance with the application process please:

* Email us at calix.interview@calix.com; or
* Call us at +1 (408) 514-3000.

Calix is a Drug Free Workplace.

jobs.title: Senior CPX Operations Manager, Customer Success
jobs.description:
The Senior CPX Operations Manager, Customer Success is an experienced core contributor responsible for driving operational efficiency, workflow optimization, and technical execution across the Customer Success (CS) organization. This role manages standard-to-moderately complex projects, executing workflows, and supporting day-to-day continuous improvement.

  

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

  

**Systems (Tools & Process) Execution**

* **Efficiency Driver:** Improve the systems (processes and tools) to drive efficiency by removing repetitive tasks for the CS team and streamlining processes, allowing them to focus on high-value customer interactions
* **Tool Optimization:** Maximize the value of our tech stack (ideally Gainsight) and partner with the Business Technology team to build automation and AI-driven workflows that allow the organization to scale
* **Requirements & Implementation:** Gather detailed business requirements from CS stakeholders and translate them into technical configurations using structured implementation methodologies

  

**Global Alignment & Change Management**

* **Process Standardization:** Support regional rollouts of global operational initiatives, ensuring teams adhere to standardized processes and best practices
* **Data Integrity:** Drive local adoption of standard workflows to safeguard data accuracy and consistency across systems
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with cross-functional teams (e.g., Business Technology, Product, Sales) to align CS tools and workflows with broader company objectives
* **Enablement:** Develop and maintain enablement resources, including playbooks, process documentation, and field communications, to support the adoption of operational initiatives. Identify and cultivate regional change champions to reinforce best practices, facilitate knowledge sharing, and drive consistent adoption across the organization

  

**Data Analysis & Insights**

* **Customer Data Management:** Design and maintain systems for collecting, consolidating, and analyzing customer interaction data and CS performance metrics
* **Reporting & Dashboards:** Build operational dashboards that provide actionable insights to CS managers and individual contributors to support informed decision-making

  

**What You’ll Need**
--------------------

  

Minimum Qualifications

* 4+ years in Operations for Customer Success or Customer Experience, preferably within a SaaS environment
Undergraduate degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience  

  

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience working in geographically dispersed teams
* Experience in leveraging technology (ideally Gainsight or similar, Salesforce, Snowflake) to automate and enhance our customer management
* Experience re-engineering processes (through automation and AI) to drive efficiency and enable scale/growth in CS teams
* Experience in gathering business requirements and implementing build/change through structure methodology
* Exceptional problem-solving, critical thinking, and analytical skills
* Solid verbal and written communication skills to translate both business needs and data insights in a clear, concise, and effective manner
* Ability to effectively interact with business partners at varying levels of organization
* Well-organized with superb project management, time management skills and attention to detail
* Ability to synthesize data into consumable insights and deliver them to stakeholders
Personable, agile, adaptable and flexible mindset  

  

**Travel Requirements and Working Conditions**

* Willingness to travel up to 15% for team and corporate meetings, fostering relationships and representing company interests
Reliable internet access for any period of time working remotely, as we embrace flexible work arrangements  

  
  
  

**How You’ll Be Rewarded**

✅ Salary range in the US: $74,000.00 - $125,000.00

✅ A discretionary bonus typically paid annually

✅ Restricted Stock Units granted at time of hire

✅ 401(k) match and comprehensive employee benefits package

The salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this job in the US. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience and other relevant factors.

**Why Join Workiva**

Workiva is the platform designed to bring confidence, control, and a competitive edge to the world’s most complex organizations. Our AI-powered platform unifies finance, risk, and sustainability on a single, secure foundation—ensuring data is trusted, traceable, and ready to act on. With an unbroken path from source to output, leaders gain confidence in their numbers, visibility into current and emerging risks, and the ability to move with speed and precision in a constantly changing world.

At Workiva, you’ll bring technology to market that executives, boards, and regulators depend on. The work you do here helps organizations navigate uncertainty, maintain trust, and make decisions that stand up to scrutiny. If you’re energized by meaningful challenges, inspired by collaborative teams, and motivated to help organizations turn uncertainty into advantage, we’d love to meet you.

Employment decisions are made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other protected characteristic.

***Consequential Work. Dedicated People.***
-------------------------------------------

**About Onebrief**
------------------

Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.

**Product Operations Manager**
------------------------------

### **Overview**

As a Product Operations Manager at Onebrief, you own whether the deployed product works the way we intend. You connect customers, product, engineering, infrastructure, and go-to-market teams. You build the systems, data pipelines, and automations that help us ship with confidence in high-stakes, mission-critical environments.

This is a hands-on, technical role. You will build 0 1 processes and tools, and use AI and automation to run them at scale.

**What you will achieve**
-------------------------

**Signal & Insight**

* Build customer feedback channels and usage and satisfaction measures (feature-usage telemetry, NPS/CSAT), and turn that data into roadmap input.
* Build dashboards for exec, support, and engineering, with automated self-checks so they stay accurate without manual audits.

**Reliability**

* Own the bug database, including intake, triage, severity levels, resolution targets, and a regular review cadence. Drive the top customer-impacting issues to resolution.
* Define and ship in-product quality-of-service measures (load delays, timeouts, crashes, failed logins), and work with InfraSec to plan STIG, POA&M, and security fixes into the roadmap.

**Release Governance**

* Define entry and exit criteria, sign-off owners, and rollback triggers for Pilot, Early Access, and General Availability. Own feature flags, rollback procedures, and release notes.
* Keep one shared view of what is shipping, to whom, and when, and report it weekly in CR OpSync. Bring InfraSec in early on high-side and ATO impacts, and produce enablement materials for Sales and Customer Relations.

**Process & Tooling**

* Run clean operating rhythms across Linear, Jira, Confluence, GitHub, Slack, and Notion. Define how customer issues are weighed against new feature work, and who communicates when something breaks or ships.
* Measure how well we execute using resolution time, escape rate, regression rate, and mean time to recovery (MTTR).

**Planning & Launches**

* Facilitate quarterly planning, roadmap alignment, and cross-team dependencies.
* Work with Product Marketing and GTM leadership to run launches and Early Access and beta programs, and make it clear to everyone at Onebrief what Product is working on, why it matters, and how it's going.

----------------------

* **Discover, build, connect, communicate.** Find what already exists and who to involve. Build the process or tool only if needed. Connect it to other teams and tools so it isn't a silo. Then record a walkthrough and share it.

* **Build with AI.** Design and maintain AI agents and automations for tasks like PRD drafting, release note checks, dashboard checks, and data grooming. Document custom builds in the ProdOps GitHub repo instead of building them ad hoc.

* **Be the "PM of PMs."** Reinforce simple, consistent practices so teams hit milestones and keep quality high.

* **Turn signals into decisions.** Make sure feedback and telemetry become roadmap and backlog changes.

* **Work across the org.** Partner closely with Engineering, Infra, Quality, InfraSec, Customer Relations, and Product Marketing. Be the one place the org can see release, reliability, and feedback status.

**About You**
-------------

You must have an active SECRET clearance or higher, and be willing to travel domestically or internationally when needed.

**Overview**

As a Project Manager, you’ll lead construction projects from planning through delivery, keeping teams aligned on scope, schedule, budget, and compliance. You’ll coordinate field and office partners, use construction management software to track progress, and act quickly when plans or site conditions change.

Your impact: Clear coordination and proactive cost and schedule management help project teams deliver safe, compliant work and give clients dependable project outcomes.

**Duties**

* Lead construction project management activities, including project coordination, team leadership, and construction schedule coordination.
* Develop and maintain project schedules, budgets, estimates, and cost controls; coordinate resources and address risks.
* Review construction plans, blueprints, schematics, and contracts; support field teams with plan interpretation and issue resolution.
* Monitor construction site activities and ensure work follows applicable construction regulations and regulatory compliance requirements.
* Use project management software and Microsoft Office; tools may include ProCore, Bluebeam, Primavera P6, Primavera, Prolog, Civil 3D, and HeavyBid.

**Requirements**

* Experience in construction project management, construction management, and construction site work; commercial construction experience is valued.

* Knowledge of construction estimating, construction budget management, construction management software, construction plans, contracts, blueprint reading, and schematics.
* Familiarity with construction regulations and compliance; experience with the listed software tools is preferred.

Pay: $30.00 - $55.00 per hour

* Collaborates - Builds effective partnerships across functions and works through shared ownership to achieve program outcomes
* Communicates Effectively - Tailors clear, timely communication to different audiences and creates visibility into decisions, risks, and progress
* Drives Results - Maintains focus on commitments, addresses obstacles, and delivers quality outcomes within agreed scope, schedule, and budget

Gigstreem is a US based national Internet Service Provider, serving Residential (Single Family, MDU) and Commercial (MTU) clients with technology solutions in markets across the country.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Project Manager leads end-to-end execution of residential capital project launches, including low voltage and network hardware installations for our managed WiFi solutions. Every project is delivered on time, within budget, and to client satisfaction.

The role works with cross-functional partners through every stage of the project lifecycle. That includes translating services sold into the Internal Statement of Work, developing and running the project plan, coordinating teams and clients, and leading the post-launch financial and operational review.

* Review and fully understand contract and pre-sale deliverables (Sales Budget, Scope of Work, Design, Circuit Provider plan, and revenue/conversion model) and translate services sold into the Internal Statement of Work.
* Develop comprehensive project plans for all assigned projects, including requirements, objectives, timelines, budgets, milestones, and resource allocation.

* Ensure each phase closes only after all deliverables are submitted.
* Ensure all tasks and activities are QC’ed by the appropriate subject matter expert (SME).

* Review and approve project-related expenses, invoices, and change orders.
* Monitor accounts receivable and assist with collections as necessary.
* Lead the post-launch financial and operational review.

Compliance, Quality & Documentation

Risk Management

jobs.title: Sr Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Senior Project Manager**
==========================

**Company:** Astute Business Solutions

**Location:** Remote (US-Based Only; No Offshore)

**Employment Type:** Full-Time Employee (FTE)

**Industry:** IT Consulting / Cloud Services

### **About Us**

Astute Business Solutions is a premier Oracle Cloud partner and specialized PeopleSoft, E-Business Suite (EBS), and Banner consulting firm headquartered in Dublin, CA. We empower enterprise clients across North America by architecting, implementing, and optimizing modern IT infrastructure and cloud environments.

### **Position Summary**

We are seeking an experienced **Senior Project Manager** to organize, manage, and plan complex, multi-workstream IT engagements. In this role, you will lead end-to-end client initiatives, including Oracle Cloud migrations (OCI / PaaS and IaaS), managed services transitions, and large-scale ERP patching and modernization roadmaps.

The ideal candidate brings a blend of traditional delivery discipline and modern cloud agility, holding an active **PMP certification** and demonstrating a proven record of managing enterprise Oracle ecosystem projects within a client-facing consulting model.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Project Delivery & Governance**

* Lead cross-functional, interdepartmental project teams to complete assigned deliverables on time, within scope, and under budget.
* Define detailed project charters, work breakdown structures (WBS), timelines, and milestones.
* Oversee and coordinate complex technical tracks, including Oracle Cloud migrations, ERP upgrades/patching, and managed services operational handoffs.
* Direct project workflow and delegate work streams to analysts, consultants, and technical engineers based on domain expertise and project constraints.

**Financial & Resource Management**

* Conduct upfront cost analysis and resource estimation to establish baseline project budgets.
* Monitor ongoing burn rates, analyze project profitability, manage change requests, and implement corrective actions when budget variances arise.

**Risk Mitigation & Quality Assurance**

* Perform continuous risk and issue assessments; maintain risk logs (RAID) and proactively deliver mitigation recommendations to steering committees and executive sponsors.
* Ensure all deliverables comply with federal, state, industry, contractual, and company standards, security policies, and consulting best practices.

**Client & Stakeholder Management**

The Implementation Specialist documents findings for each project and provides clear, concise written recommendations. jobs.description:
Heifer International is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.

**About Heifer International**

In 1944, Heifer International’s founder, Dan West, began outlining a simple but groundbreaking plan to tackle hunger around the world. West, a farmer from the Midwest and Church of the Brethren member, had recently returned from feeding weary refugees during volunteer service in the Spanish Civil War.

He had seen firsthand that giving people food was a short-term solution, whereas providing them with animals offered a steady supply of nutritious food for an entire family. His philosophy still inspires Heifer’s work today. Partnering with farmers across a range of different livestock and crops, we create unique solutions to local challenges.

Today, Heifer International has operations in 19 countries around the world, working alongside local farmers, business owners and their communities, as they mobilize and envision their futures. Together, we build inclusive, resilient economies, so communities can develop effective ways to end global hunger and poverty in a sustainable way.

To date, we have supported more than 42 million farming families across Africa, Asia and the Americas and in the past five years alone. We have worked alongside 2.7 million families to close the living income gap or set them on a path to doing so. Between now and 2030, we will support an additional 10 million people to reach a living income by scaling up our signature programs. To achieve this, Heifer International relies on its passionate, committed, and highly skilled staff.

**ROLE FUNCTION**

The Data and Operations Associate strengthens relationship-based fundraising by ensuring that donor, prospect, portfolio, opportunity, and engagement data is accurate, accessible, and useful. Through data entry, review, cleanup, reconciliation, reporting support, and analysis, this role helps fundraisers and leaders understand their portfolios and pipelines, plan effectively, and follow up consistently.

This is a hands-on role for an analytical, curious person who enjoys working carefully with data and partnering with stakeholders across the organization. A substantial part of the work involves entering, reviewing, cleaning, and reconciling records. The Associate combines accuracy and persistence in recurring tasks with the judgment to spot patterns, investigate discrepancies, and work closely with the CRM team to suggest, test, and implement system improvements.

Specific assignments, tools, and the balance of work will evolve with team needs, systems, and fundraising priorities. The supervisor will regularly establish priorities, clarify ownership with partner teams, and adjust workload and timelines. The Associate will learn new processes and take on related responsibilities that remain consistent with the role’s purpose and level.

* Analytical, curious, detail-oriented, persistent, collaborative, adaptable, and discreet; comfortable with sustained, detailed data work and changing priorities.

* Sunnyvale, CA, United States

### **Company Description**

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.

We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.

The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here.

### **Job Description**

**Primary Function of Position**

The purpose of this role is to serve as a Scientific Research Program Manager (SRPM) for the da Vinci Cardiac Surgery Program. The SRPM, Cardiac surgery will oversee the development of evidence-generation strategy for the Cardiac Surgery Program and support research projects to demonstrate the performance and impact of Intuitive Surgical's da Vinci platforms, products, and services within the United States and globally. This role oversees the initiation, progress, and conduct of evidence-generation studies, including those conducted by internal scientific teams, Intuitive-sponsored studies, and studies conducted in collaboration with external research partners. The SRPM serves as a key contact for internal and external parties involved in assigned projects.

**Essential Job Duties**

* Collaborate with Cardiac Surgery Program leaders and cross-functional evidence stakeholders to identify evidence gaps, align on evidence priorities, and develop evidence-generation plans
* Manage and execute a portfolio of internal and external collaborative research studies and evidence-generation activities for Intuitive Surgical's da Vinci platforms, products, and services, with support from research coordinators as applicable.
* Manage research studies across the study lifecycle, including project development, budgeting, investigator selection, analysis of potential participant recruitment, preparation of study-related documents (e.g., protocols, case report forms, informed consents, research agreements), and management of Institutional Review Board and/or Ethics Committee submissions through successful outcome.
* Collaborate with data management professionals and statisticians as needed; maintain required study documentation; and plan and manage project timelines and budgets to support timely execution.
* Proactively identify and communicate project concerns, issues, and delays; develop risk assessments and contingency plans; and prepare project status updates, presentations, and reports for internal and external stakeholders and steering or advisory committees.
* Manage publication development, submission, and responses to peer review related to research studies.
* Ensure compliance with corporate requirements (e.g., SOPs) and applicable regulatory requirements (e.g., GCP and U.S. and international guidelines), and maintain audit readiness to relevant regulatory and legal standards.
* Manage Contract Research Organizations (CROs) and independent research service providers, including partner identification, contract or statement-of-work development, and stakeholder management; facilitate meetings and reporting in accordance with Intuitive Surgical policies; and support review and development of internal research processes (e.g., SOPs).
* Build, nurture, and maintain relationships with external research partners and stakeholders, including surgeon key opinion leaders, operating room staff, hospital and health system administrative and technology leaders, surgical and scientific professional society leaders, and healthcare technology industry partners.

### **Qualifications**

**Required Skills and Experience**

* At least five years of experience in an academic setting or healthcare technology industry in a clinical affairs or scientific research function, with evidence of full project management responsibility; industry research management experience preferred.

jobs.title: Customer Onboarding Manager
jobs.description:
**Customer Onboarding Manager**
===============================

**Location:** Remote, United States

**Experience:** 3–5 years

**About Tessera Labs**
----------------------

Tessera Labs is redefining how enterprises modernize their most complex systems. Backed by Foundation Capital and built by leaders in AI (Artificial Intelligence) and enterprise transformation, Tessera delivers governed, multi-agent AI built specifically for ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) modernization. Tessera compresses ERP modernization from years to weeks.

**About the Role**
------------------

The Customer Onboarding Manager owns every new customer's path from the first handoff by our GTM (Go-To-Market) team to the day the customer is live in production. Your job is to make that path shorter, more predictable, and easier for the customer.

Today, the slowest part of a deal comes after the first sales conversation. Customers need internal approvals before a POC (Proof of Concept) can start: security questionnaires, compliance reviews, infrastructure and architecture questions, and procurement steps. Most of the delay sits on the customer's side, and some sits on ours. You will close both gaps.

You join the customer from the first call, build a shared onboarding plan, and track every open item until it is done. You chase approvals on the customer's side and pull in the right people on ours: GTM, TPM (Technical Project Management), Security, Compliance, and Infrastructure. You do not answer deep technical questions yourself; you make sure the right expert answers them on time.

You will also find the patterns behind the delays and fix them, turning one-off efforts into a repeatable onboarding process.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**End-to-End Onboarding Ownership**

* Take the handoff from GTM and join customer calls from the start of each engagement.
* Build a shared onboarding plan with each customer covering security review, compliance review, infrastructure questions, procurement, POC, and production go-live.
* Own the timeline, open items, and next steps for several customer onboardings at the same time.
* Keep the customer and internal teams aligned on what is done, what is blocked, and who owns each next step.

**Customer-Side Approvals**

* Map each customer's internal approval path early: who signs off on security, compliance, architecture, legal, and procurement.
* Follow up consistently with customer stakeholders to keep approvals moving.
* Help customers get what their reviewers need, such as completed questionnaires, compliance evidence, and architecture documents.
* Spot stalled approvals early and escalate through the right customer and Tessera contacts.

**Internal Coordination**

* Route customer questions to the right Tessera team (TPM, Security, Compliance, Infrastructure, or GTM) and track them to a committed answer date.
* Make sure handoffs between teams happen without dropped items or repeated questions to the customer.
* Identify internal gaps that slow onboarding, such as missing documents, slow answers, or unclear ownership, and drive fixes with the owning team.

**Process and Reporting**

* Build and maintain a repeatable onboarding playbook, including stage definitions, checklists, templates, and handoff criteria.
* Track onboarding metrics, such as time from GTM handoff to POC start and from POC to production, and report trends to leadership.
* Keep a reusable library of common customer requests and answers with the owning teams so later onboardings move faster.
* Use AI tools to speed up tracking, follow-ups, and reporting.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 3–5 years of experience in customer onboarding, implementation management, customer success, project coordination, or a similar customer-facing role at a B2B (business-to-business) software company.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the confidence to lead calls with customer stakeholders and follow up without being prompted.
* A record of running several customer engagements at once and keeping each one on schedule.
* Experience building processes from scratch, such as playbooks, checklists, and trackers, and getting other teams to use them.
* Strong organization and follow-through, with a habit of clear written status updates.
* Basic understanding of what enterprise security reviews, compliance requirements, and cloud deployments involve. You need to understand the questions well enough to route them; you do not need to answer them.
* Comfort working across teams where you have influence but not direct authority.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience onboarding enterprise customers through security reviews, vendor due diligence, or procurement at an enterprise SaaS (Software as a Service) or AI company.
* Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 (System and Organization Controls 2) or ISO/IEC 27001 (International Organization for Standardization / International Electrotechnical Commission 27001).
* Exposure to regulated or government customers with long approval cycles.
* Experience with project tracking tools such as Jira, Asana, or a CRM (Customer Relationship Management) system.
* Background at a high-growth startup.

Compensation Range: $150K - $180K

Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.
