jobs.description:
**About the role**

Tailgate Connect (TGC) is a veteran-owned tailgate experience marketplace. We connect fans with hosted tailgates at NFL, college football, and concert events across the country.

We're hiring someone to own the customer success journey, from a potential customer’s first question to the moment they're under the tent on game day. Our standards, message templates and support dashboard are already in place. You'll run them every day, and you'll be the person who updates them as we grow.

**What you'll own**

You own every standard that touches a TgC customer's journey: how we communicate to them, when we reach out, and how we resolve their issues.

* Our customer message templates for text and email.
* Our case system and the rules behind it.
* The CS playbook for anyone covering the desk.
* A debrief after each game weekend on what to improve.

***Responsibilities***

**Game day**

* Send the morning reminders to every guest with a tailgate that day, including location-change notices when a host has moved.
* Watch the live board as tailgates open across time zones, and get guests to the right tent in the event they can't find it.
* Work several cases at once, prioritising guests who have replied or are stuck over routine reminders.
* Confirm details with hosts when a guest's question needs the host's answer.

**Day to day**

* Respond to every customer inquiry by text, email and our contact form, from location questions and menu inquiries to ticket transfers.
* Triage the general inbox: attach messages to the right customer, open a case, or dismiss.
* Keep internal notes on every case so the record stands on its own.

**You're a good fit if you**

* Have customer service experience, especially in a remote role.
* Write clearly and quickly. All support is handled by text and email; no customer phone calls are expected.
* Stay calm when it's busy. A game day often has many tailgates running at once, and several open cases at the same time is normal.
* Must work weekends and early mornings during the season.
* Are comfortable learning a custom admin dashboard and giving honest feedback on how it could work better.
* Have an interest in a career in tailgating and live events.
* Want to join a growing team where you'll genuinely shape the culture.

Pay: $50.00 - $250.00 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote

jobs.description:
**Company Overview:**

**EZ-ACCESS**, a leading manufacturer of aluminum ramps and accessibility solutions, is dedicated to improving mobility and independence. As a DBA of Homecare Products, Inc., we design and manufacture high-quality products for residential, commercial, and industrial applications.

**Position Overview:**

**EZ-ACCESS** is seeking a **Senior Account Manager** to join our Sales team. This role is responsible for growing EZ-ACCESS sales through national and regional industrial distributors, B2B e-commerce platforms and an independent broker network.

On the sales side, this position wins new distributor and end-user business, manages and holds brokers accountable, negotiates programs and terms, and builds a reliable pipeline and forecast. On the e-commerce side, this position ensures every priority product is set up, priced, merchandised and discoverable on distributor websites, supplier portals and B2B marketplaces, so that online demand converts into orders.

The Senior Account Manager serves as the primary point of coordination for the industrial channel among Sales, Marketing, Product, Pricing, Accounting, Operations and Customer Service. The ideal candidate is a self-directed builder who can create repeatable processes, work independently in a remote role and grow into leading a larger channel team.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Industrial Sales and Account Growth**

· Own revenue, gross margin, sell-through and market-share targets for assigned industrial distributor accounts.

· Grow existing accounts by expanding assortment, adding new SKUs and product lines, and increasing share of category.

· Identify, pursue and open new distributors in industrial MRO, safety, facilities, construction and related supply channels.

· Lead account negotiations, including programs, terms, rebates, co-op, freight and annual agreements, within approved guidelines.

· Conduct quarterly business reviews with distributor buyers and category managers covering performance, forecasts, promotions and growth plans.

· Develop target end-user verticals, such as data centers, utilities, facilities and commercial construction, and build the programs and specification support needed to win projects.

· Prepare customer presentations, line reviews, new-item submissions and proposals.

· Maintain key contacts, call notes, opportunities and pipeline in the CRM on a timely basis.

**Broker and Rep Network Management**

· Own relationships with independent brokers and sales agencies representing EZ-ACCESS to industrial distributors.

· Recruit, onboard and train brokers on EZ-ACCESS products, pricing, programs and value proposition.

· Set clear goals, territories and account responsibilities, and administer commission structures within approved agreements.

· Hold monthly pipeline reviews and quarterly performance reviews with each broker.

· Track broker performance with scorecards, expand what works and recommend corrective action where performance falls short.

· Join brokers on key customer calls, line reviews and trade shows to strengthen relationships and gather market feedback.

· Provide brokers and distributor sales teams with the sales kit, training and support materials needed to sell effectively.

jobs.description:
**OptioRx**

OptioRx is a dynamic premier national compounding pharmacy providing best in class patient care. We serve 50 states and are committed to fostering a team environment rooted in trust, innovation, efficiency, accountability, integrity, and energy.

**Position Summary**

The Sales Representative is responsible for generating qualified leads, conducting outbound prospecting, and supporting early-stage customer engagement for OptioRx sales initiatives. This role follows established playbooks, uses CRM tools accurately, communicates company offerings clearly, and helps build foundational customer relationships that support pipeline growth.

**Must work MST or CST**

ESSENTIAL DUTIES

* Conduct cold calls, emails, and other outbound prospecting activities in accordance with established sales processes and outreach standards.
* Identify and qualify prospective customers by asking basic discovery questions, documenting needs, and determining appropriate next steps.
* Communicate OptioRx products, services, and value propositions clearly and professionally to prospects and customers.
* Maintain accurate and timely CRM records, including outreach activity, contact information, prospect status, notes, and follow-up tasks.
* Handle straightforward customer interactions, qualifying questions, objections, and routine informational requests using approved scripts, playbooks, and resources.
* Support departmental outreach goals by completing assigned calls, emails, follow-ups, appointments, and lead-generation activities.
* Escalate complex customer questions, non-standard requests, or higher-value opportunities to more experienced sales team members or leadership.
* Participate in sales training, team meetings, coaching sessions, and campaign activities to strengthen product knowledge, prospecting skills, and sales effectiveness.
* Collaborate with teammates by sharing prospect information, customer insights, and market feedback that may improve sales outreach or pipeline development.
* Demonstrate professionalism, resilience, persistence, and strong customer service while representing OptioRx in prospect and customer interactions.
* Schedule introductory meetings, follow-up calls, or handoffs with more experienced sales team members when prospects demonstrate potential interest.
* Maintain consistent follow-up with assigned leads using approved outreach cadences, scripts, and communication templates.
* Support lead nurturing by sending approved materials, documenting prospect responses, and tracking next steps in the CRM.
* Assist with basic research on prospective customers, target accounts, and contact information to support outreach preparation.
* Provide timely updates to sales leadership or senior sales team members regarding prospect activity, barriers, and potential opportunities.
* Support newly identified account opportunities by organizing initial notes, contact details, and customer needs for transition to the appropriate sales owner.

NON-ESSENTIAL DUTIES

* Assist with sales campaigns, market research, CRM cleanup, customer lists, and outreach projects as requested.
* Support onboarding or cross-training activities by sharing basic process knowledge once proficient in assigned responsibilities.

QUALIFICATIONS

* 0–1 years sales experience; high school diploma required, bachelor’s degree preferred.
* Basic understanding of customer service, outbound communication, lead generation, objection handling, and time management.
* Ability to learn company products, services, value propositions, target customer profiles, sales terminology, CRM systems, and prospecting techniques.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interact professionally with prospects, customers, and internal teams.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate CRM documentation with minimal errors.
* Ability to follow established priorities, workflows, scripts, and standard operating procedures while receiving frequent coaching and feedback.
* Ability to sit or stand for extended periods, use a computer and phone, and perform routine office-based work.
* Ability to conduct basic prospect research and prepare for outreach using available tools and approved resources.
* Comfortable making high-volume outbound calls and sending professional follow-up communications.
* Ability to recognize when a prospect requires escalation to a more experienced sales team member.
* Willingness to learn sales processes, product knowledge, customer profiles, and CRM expectations through coaching and training.

CORE COMPETENCIES

* Prospecting Discipline: Consistently completes targeted outreach activities, follows established sales processes, and maintains focus on generating qualified opportunities.
* Customer Service: Communicates professionally, responds to customer and prospect needs appropriately, and represents OptioRx with a service-oriented approach.
* CRM Accuracy: Maintains complete, timely, and accurate records of outreach activity, prospect information, notes, and follow-up tasks.
* Communication: Clearly conveys information through verbal and written interactions while adapting messaging to prospects, customers, and internal team members.
* Time Management: Organizes daily priorities, completes assigned outreach and follow-up activities, and manages work efficiently within established expectations.
* Resilience and Persistence: Maintains professionalism and motivation through rejection, objections, and repeated outreach while continuing to pursue sales goals.
* Coachability: Receives feedback, applies direction, and continues developing foundational sales skills.
* Attention to Detail: Captures accurate prospect information, next steps, and activity notes to support effective handoffs and follow-up.

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

* Revenue
* Product mix
* Daily activity, including phone calls in prospecting, sales cycle 1, and sales cycle 2
* New accounts added

Dropbox is a Virtual First company. For this role, we are hiring in Zones 2 and 3. Zones are determined by your zip code; if you’re within 100 miles of a listed metro area (straight-line radius), you’re included in that Zone. Please

### **Your Zone**

Check

Read more about our Benefits.

### **Company Description**

Dropbox isn’t just a workplace—it’s a living lab for designing a more enlightened way of working. We’re a global community of bold visionaries and resourceful doers shaping the future of Dropbox and, in turn, the future of work. Our Virtual First model combines the autonomy of a distributed workplace with the power of human connection, creating space for meaningful work and lasting relationships. With a startup mindset and enterprise-level opportunities, we expect Dropbox employees to think critically, stay curious, and use modern tools, including AI, to improve how work gets done. Here, you can be who you are and grow into who you’re meant to be. You own your impact, helping make work more intuitive, joyful, and human for yourself and hundreds of millions of people worldwide. If you’re ready to push boundaries and challenge yourself, Dropbox is ready for you.

The Dropbox Legal, Policy, Trust & Privacy Team safeguards our company to enable innovation while protecting our users, platform, and business. Our team navigates complex challenges at the intersection of technology and law, embracing agility to tackle the changing landscape while ensuring compliance and integrity. From governance, risk & compliance to public policy, we combine creative problem-solving with subject-matter expertise expertise to help our employees and users work securely, drive responsible growth, and shape the future of policy around technology. If you're excited about protecting trust in the digital age, join our Legal team.

### **Virtual First**

Dropbox’s Virtual First way of working is designed to help people do their best work with flexibility, autonomy, and connection. Day to day, teams work remotely with nonlinear schedules and core collaboration hours that support deep focus and individual working styles. We prioritize asynchronous communication to improve clarity, respect deep work time, and reduce unnecessary meetings. While remote work is the primary experience for our employees, we also prioritize intentional, in-person connection. We bring teams together through regular team gatherings, on-demand workspaces, and Dropbox Neighborhood events in order to strengthen team cohesion, foster creativity, and enhance momentum. AI fluency is a core part of how we work and grow. It’s not about being an expert—it’s about using these tools thoughtfully and effectively to improve your work and support others.

***If you're passionate about building strong client relationships, driving commercial growth and uncovering new opportunities in the evolving payments landscape, this is your chance to make a real impact.***  
  
**What you'll do as an Account Manager**

* Own and grow a portfolio of clients across the US, building trusted relationships with key stakeholders and senior decision makers
* Develop account plans to understand client objectives, identify growth opportunities and strengthen long-term partnerships
* Drive commercial growth through cross-selling, upselling and identifying opportunities to expand existing client relationships.
* Lead regular client business reviews, analysing performance metrics and analysing trends to identify opportunities and deliver value.
* Manage contract renewals, pricing discussions and commercial negotiations to maximise revenue and client retention.

* Use payments industry knowledge and market insights to anticipate client needs, identify risks and recommend opportunities for growth.
* Monitor transaction volumes, account performance and market trends to identify risks, growth opportunities and areas for improvement.
* Proactively manage client expectations, resolve sensitive issues and ensure a consistently high standard of client service.
* Develop a deep understanding of clients' business models and the payments landscape to anticipate needs, identify growth opportunities, deliver exceptional client experiences and build long-term, commercially successful partnerships.

**What you'll bring as an experienced Account Manager**

* Proven experience in account management within payments or fintech, with a strong understanding of payment processing; issuer processing experience is highly desirable.
* Excellent written and verbal communication.
* A track record of building and maintaining client relationships.
* Strong experience driving revenue growth, identifying cross-selling and upselling opportunities and managing contract negotiations.
* A client first mindset, with the ability to manage complex or sensitive relationships and drive long-term satisfaction and retention.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Confidence managing challenging conversations, resolving conflicts diplomatically and influencing stakeholders to achieve positive outcomes.
* A collaborative, proactive approach, with the ability to work cross-functionally and influence teams in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
* A commercially driven and adaptable mindset, combining strategic thinking, attention to detail and professionalism under pressure.

**Where you'll work**  
Our working model varies depending on the specific role and team requirements. We strive to provide flexibility whilst ensuring that each position is best supported for optimal collaboration and performance.  
  
**About us**  
Thredd is the trusted next-gen payments partner for innovators looking to modernise their payments offering. Certified by Mastercard, Visa and Diners & Discover, we process billions of debit, prepaid, and credit transactions annually, supporting consumer and corporate fintechs, digital banks, and embedded finance providers across the globe. Our unique offering is our client-centric approach, combining hands-on support with modern, reliable, and scalable technology.  
Our assured solution accelerates the development and delivery of consumer and corporate payments components embedded within digital banks, as well as for expense management, B2B payments, crypto, lending, credit, Buy Now Pay Later, FX, remittance, and open banking innovators.  
Since 2007, Thredd has enabled market leaders through our highly reliable, secure, and scalable platform and supported many of our client's growth journeys - from early-stage startup through to globally recognized unicorns, including Monzo, Revolut, and Starling.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Operations Process
jobs.description:
Gatik, the leader in autonomous middle-mile logistics, is revolutionizing the B2B supply chain with its autonomous transportation-as-a-service (ATaaS) solution and prioritizing safe, consistent deliveries while streamlining freight movement by reducing congestion. The company focuses on short-haul, B2B logistics for Fortune 500 retailers and in 2021 launched the world's first fully driverless commercial transportation service with Walmart. Gatik's Class 3-7 autonomous trucks are commercially deployed across major markets, including Texas, Arkansas, and Ontario, Canada, driving innovation in freight transportation.

The company's proprietary Level 4 autonomous technology, Gatik Carrier™, is custom-built to transport freight safely and efficiently between pick-up and drop-off locations on the middle mile. With robust capabilities in both highway and urban environments, Gatik Carrier™ serves as an all-encompassing solution that integrates advanced software and hardware powering the fleet, facilitating effortless integration into customers' logistics operations.

**About the Role**

Gatik is looking for a detail-oriented, improvement-minded **Program Manager, Operations Process** to own and improve the workflows that power our autonomous trucking operations. In this role, you will lead process creation, process review, and workflow design, and maintain the templates, standards, and gates that keep quality consistent across every operational workstream. Reporting to the Sr. Manager, Operational Excellence, you will partner closely with subject matter experts across Operations, Fleet Maintenance, Safety, Training, and Engineering to turn operational knowledge into clear, standardized, scalable processes. You will be instrumental in maintaining quality and consistency while driving lean practices and continuous improvement.

This role is **remote** in the **USA,** with travel to sites.

**What You'll Do**

* **Own processes end to end.** Act as the accountable owner for assigned operational processes across workstreams, keeping them current, consistent, and aligned from start to finish.
* **Design and maintain workflows.** Build, document, and maintain operational workflows, including process maps, SOPs, RACI charts, and handoffs between teams.
* **Set templates and standards.** Create and maintain standard templates for processes, SOPs, work instructions, and change requests so documentation looks and works the same everywhere.
* **Run process gating.** Run quality gates and approvals for new and changed processes so they meet quality, safety, and readiness standards before rollout.
* **Lead process creation.** Partner with stakeholders to scope, design, and launch new processes as operations and markets grow.
* **Run process reviews.** Hold regular reviews to audit existing processes, find gaps or drift, and drive updates.
* **Partner with subject matter experts.** Work closely with SMEs to capture expertise, validate process design, and secure adoption by the teams doing the work.
* **Drive lean practices.** Apply lean tools (value stream mapping, waste elimination, standard work, root cause analysis) to simplify workflows and improve quality and efficiency.
* **Manage process change.** Own version control and change management for process updates, working with Training to make sure changes are communicated and trained before rollout.
* **Improve continuously.** Gather feedback from the field and turn it into targeted process improvements.

**What We're Looking For**

#### **Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of experience in process engineering, operational excellence, quality, program management, or business process management.
* Experience owning and maintaining processes across several teams or workstreams.
* Experience designing workflows, writing SOPs, and building documentation templates.
* Experience running process review or approval mechanisms.
* Working knowledge of lean principles and tools.
* Strong ability to work with subject matter experts and turn complex operational knowledge into clear, usable processes.
* Proficiency with process mapping and documentation tools such as Lucidchart, Visio, Miro, or Confluence.

#### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in autonomous vehicles, trucking, logistics, fleet maintenance, or other safety-critical operations.
* Lean Six Sigma Yellow or Green Belt, or equivalent lean training.
* Experience with quality management systems or frameworks such as ISO 9001.
* Experience in a startup or high-growth environment where processes were still being defined.
* Familiarity with change management methodologies such as Prosci or ADKAR.
* Experience with workflow tools such as Jira, ServiceNow, or Smartsheet.

**More about Gatik**

Founded in 2017 by experts in autonomous vehicle technology, Gatik has rapidly expanded its presence to Mountain View, Dallas-Fort Worth, Arkansas, and Toronto. As the *first and only* company to achieve fully driverless middle-mile commercial deliveries, Gatik holds a unique and defensible position in the AV industry, with a clear trajectory toward sustainable growth and profitability.

We have delivered complete, proprietary AV technology - an integration of software and hardware - to enable earlier successes for our clients in constrained Level 4 autonomy. By choosing the middle mile – with defined point-to-point delivery, we have simplified some of the more complex AV challenges, enabling us to achieve full autonomy ahead of competitors. Given extensive knowledge of Gatik's well-defined, fixed route ODDs and hybrid architecture, we are able to hyper-optimize our models with exponentially less data, establish gate-keeping mechanisms to maintain explainability, and ensure continued safety of the system for unmanned operations.

new_jobs.title: Equity, Systems and Process Improvement Community Program Specialist II - IHSS (Open)
new_jobs.description:
San Mateo County Health is seeking a dynamic and experienced leader to serve as the **Equity, Systems and Process Improvement Community Program Specialist II – In-Home Supportive Services Public Authority (ESPI CPS II)** within Aging and Disability Services (ADS).

This position supports the ongoing improvement and modernization of the In-Home Supportive Services (IHSS) Public Authority (PA) by developing automated systems, dashboards, and digital tools that enhance program operations, service accessibility, and staff productivity. The role also assists with caregiver recruitment and onboarding, referral coordination, and the development of policies, procedures, and training materials, while ensuring that all initiatives incorporate racial equity, diversity, and inclusion principles.

**Important Note:** The IHSS PA ESPI Community Program Specialist **is not a County classified position;** however, the role reports directly within ADS. The eligible list generated from this recruitment may be used to fill future extra-help, term, unclassified and regular classified vacancies.

This is a full-time position working Monday–Friday. A hybrid schedule may be available; however, approximately four on-site workdays per week are anticipated based on operational needs and County requirements. The position is currently located in San Mateo, CA, but will relocate to South San Francisco, CA, planned for March 2027. The role requires travel throughout the County and periodic travel within the State of California.

**About the IHSS Public Authority**

Established by the San Mateo County Board of Supervisors in 1993, the IHSS Public Authority administers the care provider components of the County’s IHSS program.

IHSS supports Medi-Cal eligible individuals who are aged, blind or living with disabilities at any age so they can safely remain in their homes as an alternative to institutional care.

**The IHSS Public Authority:**

* Serves as the employer of record for approximately 10,000 IHSS care providers
* Operates a Registry that recruits, screens, and refers care providers to IHSS recipients
* Conducts background checks in accordance with IHSS regulations
* Provides training opportunities to enhance care provider skills
* Offers support to both recipients and care providers to promote successful working relationships
* Administers payroll, personnel services, health benefits, and COBRA
* Maintains employment records, conducts verifications, and responds to subpoenas
* The IHSS PA is advised by the Public Authority Advisory Committee (PAAC), appointed by the Board of Supervisors, with a majority of the members being current or former IHSS recipients and/or care providers.

**Key Responsibilities**

**The** **IHSS PA ESPI Community Program Specialist** **will:**

* Assist in development and maintenance of systems, automated tools, and improvement charters designed to boost IHSS PA operations utilizing both AAS’ Racial Equity Action Plan (REAP) and LEAP process improvement standards
* Implement Quality Assurance (QA) standards in the development and maintenance of dashboards and reporting systems that will be used in IHSS PA work processes, as well as monitor staff workload and productivity
* Assist in the development and maintenance of a self-service portal for referral submissions by external entities
* Assist in the development and maintenance of an online job board intended to help match IHSS recipients with care providers, implementing equity, diversity, and inclusion standards.
* Assist in the migration of paper-driven onboarding processes to digital processes, a process that will expedite accessibility of newly hired care providers to IHSS recipients
* Assist in recruiting and onboarding care providers, to help remediate the current care provider shortage, utilizing a racial equity lens
* Work with the IHSS PA Supervisors to devise, triage, and assign referrals to Payroll Specialists and Registry Social Workers
* Work closely with IHSS Community Program Analysts in the development and maintenance of automation-related projects designed to enhance the accessibility of Payroll and Registry services for IHSS recipients
* Update existing and create new IHSS PA policies and procedures to reflect current and new programmatic practices
* Update existing training materials and training IHSS PA staff, integrating a social and equity lens

The **ideal candidate** will be:

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, well suited for large government or non-profit social service programs.
* Experience working with case management databases like the Case Management, Information and Payrolling Services (CMIPS II) and Microsoft Suite Applications (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Excel).
* Experience with process improvement best practices and LEAP process improvement principles and methodologies.
* Experience training community members and/or staff in programmatic updates and new operational requirements requiring updated work practices.
* Strong understanding of social and racial equity principles leading to the County of San Mateo’s Equity Framework.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Knowledge of:**

* Principles, practices, and administrative requirements of the program to which assigned.
* Contemporary social, political and economic trends and problems related to community services.
* Principles of social planning and program development related to community services.
* Specialized technical knowledge related to assigned program area.
* Monitoring and evaluating systems for community services programs.
* Current social and community needs.
* Principles and practices in community development and services planning.
* Methods applied to the collection and evaluation of statistical data.
* Principles of community organization.
* Applicable federal, state and local laws, rules and regulations and County and program policies and guidelines.
* Computer applications related to the work.

As Manager of Operational Safety, you will lead the team responsible for safety systems, incident response, and SOP governance for DoorDash's autonomous robot operations. new_jobs.title: Finance Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
### **Description**

**Job Summary**:

The Finance Operations Manager is responsible for the day-to-day management and execution of assigned Finance Operations functions across HNIB. Operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with significant M&A activity, this role takes ownership of core FinOps workstreams, complex operational issues, agency integrations, and process improvements that support the organization’s continued growth.

The position requires hands-on management, strong problem-solving skills, knowledge of the general ledger, and excellent communication skills. The Manager is accountable for the accurate and timely execution of assigned processes, the independent resolution of issues, and close collaboration with Operations and Agency Principals to integrate and streamline newly acquired agencies while maintaining financial integrity.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:**  
Leadership and Team Development

* Manage assigned day-to-day Finance Operations activities across Direct Bill, Cash Receipts, Payables, and related banking functions, with accountability for timely and accurate execution.
* Coach and develop FinOps leads and team members, keeping the team engaged and motivated while adjusting responsibilities to foster growth, accountability, and operational knowledge.
* Take ownership of complex operational issues within assigned areas, drive investigations through resolution, and escalate significant risks or decisions as appropriate.
* Foster a collaborative environment with clear accountability and follow-through, balancing consistent procedures with the evolving needs of the business.

Operations, Process & Systems

* Oversee and improve operational workflows, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and audit compliance while adapting to shifting priorities and building scalable processes as the organization grows.
* Coordinate directly with Accounting, IT, Operations, and Finance leadership to execute system and process changes impacting assigned Finance Operations activities.
* Maintain clear, current process documentation for assigned Finance Operations functions and ensure procedures are followed as processes evolve.
* Drive standardization and efficiency across acquired agencies and operational teams, identifying gaps and implementing practical solutions.
* Serve as the primary Finance Operations liaison to Operations for assigned M&A integrations; own the transition of newly acquired agencies into standardized workflows, resolve integration issues, and coordinate with Accounting and agency teams through implementation.
* Own year-end procedures and audit deliverables for Finance Operations, ensuring timely completion and resolution of outstanding issues.

General Ledger & Cash Management

* Apply strong general ledger knowledge to ensure assigned Finance Operations activity is accurately reflected in financial reporting.
* Own the investigation and resolution of discrepancies between operational subledgers and the general ledger, coordinating with Accounting counterparts as needed.
* Resolve accounting and reconciliation issues arising from operational transactions and guide team members on their financial impact.
* Monitor daily cash positions across HNIB and its subsidiaries, identify funding or liquidity needs, and promptly communicate and act on exceptions.
* Coordinate approved movement and sweeping of excess subsidiary cash, ensuring transactions are accurate, timely, and properly recorded.
* Proactively identify, investigate, and communicate operational issues affecting cash timing, reconciliations, or financial reporting; drive corrective action.

Team Player and Role Model:

* Be a role model for the finance team, embodying the organization's values and promoting a culture of excellence, integrity, and accountability.
* Communicate clearly, directly, and proactively with agency leaders, Operations, Accounting, and other cross-functional teams; own follow-through on issues and commitments.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

Education

* Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in Finance, Accounting, or a related business discipline.

Experience

* 5–7 years of experience in finance, accounting, or financial operations, including 1–3 years of supervisory or management experience.
* Strong general ledger knowledge, problem-solving skills, and written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience with M&A integrations, multi-entity operations, or the insurance industry is a plus.

  

### **Why Choose Heffernan?**

  

At Heffernan, our culture is guided by the Heffernan Habits, prioritizing communication, respect, fun, community impact, and celebrating what makes each of us unique. We’re proud of our strong commitment to philanthropy and giving back, and we support our employees with a comprehensive benefits package designed to promote well-being, growth, and long-term success.
  
  
**Heffernan Habits:**

These are core values that represent our unique culture.

* ***Answer The Phone (And Email):*** Communication is the foundation of success in life, work, and relationships. It begins with being present and responsive to both clients and colleagues. Listen to what is said and notice what goes unsaid.
* ***Have Fun:*** Fun is something we don’t shy away from, and participation brings us together on many different levels. Take the time to know your colleagues and let barriers fall away. If we are happy and enjoy time together, we will do a better job for our clients and for one another!
* ***Be Respectful*****:** Lend a hand, be kind, and smooth the path. Respect is the cornerstone of developing and maintaining strong relationships. Lead with humility, take ownership of your actions, and ease the way for others. We are in this together as a team, as a family, and as trusted advisors to many.
* ***Do Good*****:** This is our core. We strive to do good for our clients, our community, and our planet.

* Under the direction of the pharmacist, exercises independent judgment to ensure compliance and execution of all business administrative activities and pharmacy inventory management tasks that do not require pharmacist licensure. Manages annual inventory preparation.
* Accountable for completion of non-clinical patient calls.
* Drives new technology/ process roll out, champions change and engages team around action planning. Assures proper operation and maintenance of pharmacy department equipment. In collaboration with Pharmacy Manager, responsible for recordkeeping and ensuring security safeguards are in-place.

* Assists and supports Store Manager and Pharmacy Manager in analyzing and seeking to improve pharmacy financials, operational quality and customer service.
* Manages Community Outreach Portal and coordinates and, at the direction of the Pharmacy Manager, assigns pharmacists to off-site immunization clinics and community events. Builds and sustains relationships with retail partnerships.

**People & Performance Management**

* Leads performance management of technicians including making decisions and recommendations regarding discipline and termination. Follows constructive discipline policy to discipline, suspend, terminate or effectively recommend the same. Uses constructive discipline policy to ensure pharmacy technicians are compliant with state and federal laws. Holds technician accountable for attendance and timeliness. Maintains and improves performance of pharmacy through team member engagement and action planning.
* Accountable for technician hiring, on-boarding, training, and scheduling. Monitors and holds pharmacy technicians accountable for timely training completion. Follows established policies and procedures set by the company for scheduling and training.
* Accountable for identifying gaps in pharmacy operations knowledge among team members and supporting those team members in their training, either through hands-on training or assignment of learning modules.
* Assists Pharmacy Manager in monitoring that all pharmacy and team member licensures, registrations and certifications are active and in good standing/ compliant with all regulatory and legal requirements. Leverages Walgreens resources such as Walgreens Online Verification System to assist in documenting licensure status.

new_jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager - Northern California
new_jobs.description:
**Assistant Project Manager**

**Onsite – Hayward, CA**

### **Build Something That Makes an Impact.**

At AD/S, we bring ideas to life through custom signage, architectural features, displays, and fixtures that make a lasting impression. From illuminated landmarks that transform city skylines to wayfinding systems that guide people through airports, hospitals, resorts, and other major destinations, our work is seen and experienced every day.

We’re looking for an experienced Assistant Project Manager to join our team and support projects from contract award through final installation. If you thrive on staying organized, coordinating details, building strong customer relationships, solving problems, and keeping teams moving toward a common goal, we want to hear from you.

In this role, you’ll work closely with Project Managers to help drive project execution by coordinating schedules, monitoring budgets, tracking deliverables, and communicating with customers and internal teams. You’ll collaborate with our sales, design, engineering, manufacturing, and installation departments to help ensure projects stay on track, meet expectations, and are completed successfully.

### **What You’ll Do**

* Support Projects from Start to Finish: Assist Project Managers with all phases of assigned projects, including design, permitting, fabrication, delivery, and installation.
* Monitor Budgets and Costs: Work with Project Managers to track project expenses, monitor budgets, review profitability, and help ensure projects stay within allocated funds.
* Keep Teams Aligned: Coordinate schedules, milestones, and deliverables across internal departments, subcontractors, vendors, and customers.
* Build Customer Relationships: Maintain clear and consistent communication with customers, provide project updates, address questions, and help deliver a high level of customer service.
* Coordinate Field Activities: Conduct site visits, monitor project progress, assess site conditions, and work with installation teams to address field-related challenges.
* Interpret Project Documentation: Review and interpret blueprints, construction drawings, specifications, and design packages. Perform take-offs and help ensure project requirements are understood.
* Coordinate Subcontractors: Assist Project Managers with obtaining estimates, negotiating pricing, and coordinating subcontractors for permitting, installation, and related services.
* Monitor Progress: Maintain accurate project records, track milestones, and monitor multiple projects using company software, customized reports, and internal systems.
* Manage Project Updates: Assist with scope changes, change orders, scheduling updates, documentation, and invoicing while helping ensure project costs and deliverables are properly tracked.
* Support Quality and Closeout: Work with internal teams to monitor quality, resolve project issues, and ensure deliverables align with customer expectations and agreed-upon specifications.

### **What You Bring**

* Strong organizational, planning, and customer service skills.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Attention to detail and problem-solving abilities.
* Positive attitude, persistence, and a high level of integrity.
* Ability to work independently while contributing to a team-oriented environment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, and Word.
* Valid driver's license (minimum Class C), satisfactory driving record, and ability to maintain auto insurance coverage.

### **Education/Training/Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent work experience.
* OSHA 30 certification is a plus.
* Five years of relevant professional experience. Sign or construction industry experience required.
* Valid driver's license (minimum Class C), satisfactory driving record, and ability to maintain auto insurance coverage.

### **Perks & Benefits**

We believe great work starts with a great team. AD/S offers:

* Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance.
* Paid vacation, sick time, and holidays.
* 401(k) retirement plan with company matching after the qualifying period.
* Employee referral bonuses and discounts.
* A collaborative environment where craftsmanship, teamwork, and professional growth matter.

### **Why AD/S?**

At AD/S, you won’t just support projects, you’ll help create the signs, structures, and visual experiences that make places recognizable and help people navigate the world around them.

Our success is built on craftsmanship, teamwork, accountability, and integrity. We take pride in what we create, how we work together, and the relationships we build along the way.

If you’re ready to take on new challenges, strengthen your project management skills, and see your work come to life on a larger scale, we invite you to build your next career chapter with AD/S.

**AD/S is an E-Verify Employer. All hires are subject to background checks and drug testing.**

new_jobs.title: Sr Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
**At DPR, roles and responsibilities are more than describing a job title—they are a commitment to building great things together. The job description(s) below defines core responsibilities and the scope of the role and is a starting point. Every employee is expected to lead from where they are, take ownership of outcomes, and always act in the best interest of the team, customer, project and organization.**  
  
**As a purpose-driven organization on a journey to be most admired, we rely on trust, shared leadership, open communication, disciplined action and a deep respect for the individual to drive exceptional performance. Success is not just about what we build, but who we build and how we build it: with integrity, enjoyment, uniqueness and an ever-forward mindset.**

**Job Summary:**  
Leads all aspects of project delivery from preconstruction through closeout, ensuring projects meet DPR Construction’s standards for safety, quality, schedule, and financial performance. Oversees project teams and partners with clients, designers, and trade partners to achieve strategic goals and operational excellence. Partners with the Senior Superintendent as a unified project leadership team, sharing responsibility and accountability for project execution, field integration, and overall team performance. Establishes and maintains dependable project controls processes that keeps the team in alignment with the Prime Agreement (schedule, document control, cost management), project success goals and allows for early detection of issues so they can be mitigated. Develops and implements project execution plans, manages risk, and ensures alignment with DPR’s values and best practices. Supports the development of future leaders by mentoring project managers and engineers. Promotes a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement across all project phases.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**  
Oversees the full project lifecycle from business award through final completion, ensuring delivery of scope, budget, schedule, safety, and quality objectives.
  
Manages and directs project teams, including project managers, project engineers, and field operations staff, ensuring alignment with project execution plans and organizational standards, while setting expectations for consistent field presence, reinforcing leadership participation in safety meetings including stretch and flex, and overseeing team fluency and engagement in high-risk activities to drive safe, planned, and controlled outcomes across the project.
  
Builds and maintains relationships with clients, designers, and trade partners to promote collaboration and resolve challenges proactively.
  
Reviews and approves major project decisions, including budgets, contracts, and schedule adjustments, in coordination with project executives and senior leadership.
  
Leads project risk management and mitigation planning, ensuring compliance with DPR’s operational and safety standards.
  
Mentors and develops team members by providing ongoing coaching, delivering structured performance feedback, and guiding individualized development and training plans, strengthening leadership capability and long-term talent growth within DPR’s management framework.
  
Drives continuous improvement initiatives by identifying lessons learned and implementing process enhancements to strengthen project delivery.
  
  
**Education Qualifications:**  
Bachelor’s degree in construction management, engineering, architecture, or a related field, or equivalent experience required.
  
  
**Work Experience:**  
7-10 years of experience in construction project management, including 5 years in a leadership capacity required.
  
Experience managing large, complex commercial, healthcare, life sciences, or advanced technology projects required.
  
  
**Certifications and Licenses:**  
Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) 30-Hour Construction certification preferred. OSHA 30 program completion within 6 months of hire is required.

**Anticipated starting pay range:**

$180,000.00- $200,000.00

***Nothing is more important than your health and wellness. DPR offers a variety of medical, dental, vision and wellness benefits to keep you healthy. Read more about eligibility and available benefits programs***

***for*** skilled craft and labor or experienced professionals and recent graduates .

DPR Construction is a forward-thinking, self-performing general contractor specializing in technically complex and sustainable projects for the advanced technology, life sciences, healthcare, higher education and commercial markets. Founded in 1990, DPR is a great story of entrepreneurial success as a private, employee-owned company that has grown into a multi-billion-dollar family of companies with offices around the world.

Working at DPR, you'll have the chance to try new things, explore unique paths and shape your future. Here, we build opportunity together—by harnessing our talents, enabling curiosity and pursuing our collective ambition to make the best ideas happen. We are proud to be recognized as a great place to work by our talented teammates and leading news organizations like U.S. News and World Report, Forbes, Fast Company and Newsweek.

Explore our open opportunities at www.dpr.com/careers .

new_jobs.title: Capital Planning and Project Manager I/II (Capital Projects)
new_jobs.description:
**ABOUT US**
------------

At the County of Marin, our employees overwhelmingly report feeling their work is meaningful, they like the work they do, and they are proud to tell people “I work for the County of Marin.” Discover more about us, our values and our organizational culture on the Department of Human Resources website. Read on to find out more about this opportunity.

The mission of the Marin County Department of Public Works is To provide quality services and maintain and improve public infrastructure and facilities, while protecting Marin’s natural resources. Read more about the Department of Public Works at https://publicworks.marincounty.gov/.

**ABOUT THE POSITION**
----------------------

**Flex recruitment:**  
There are currently three (3) full-time, regular hire Capital Planning and Project Manager I/II (CPPM I/II) vacancies in the Capital Projects Division. Candidates will be considered for the level they meet minimum qualifications.

Working under the direction of the Capital Division Manager and in coordination with senior project management staff, the Capital Planning and Project Manager I and II positions support the delivery of Capital Improvement Projects from the planning and design phases through construction and project closeout. These positions provide project coordination and management support to help ensure projects are delivered safely, efficiently, within approved budgets and schedules, and in accordance with applicable requirements.

The Capital Planning and Project Manager I and II work closely with County project managers, design consultants, contractors, internal departments, and other project stakeholders in the delivery of Capital Projects. Responsibilities include assisting with the development and coordination of Request for Proposals from design consultants and other vendors, documenting design progress meetings, developing contract documents, uploading documents to an online bidding platform and overseeing the contract award process with administrative staff.

These positions help monitor project progress, schedules, budgets, and compliance with state-mandated safety requirements, and work with project team members to identify and address issues that may affect successful project delivery.

This is an excellent opportunity to build a career in capital project management while gaining hands-on experience with planning, coordination, construction, and closeout of projects that make a meaningful difference in the community. Successful candidates will have the opportunity to develop valuable project management skills, work alongside experienced professionals, and take on increasing levels of responsibility as their knowledge and expertise grow.

  
  
**Hybrid schedule:**

The Department of Public Works has embraced a **hybrid work schedule** that considers that some duties of this position may be performed remotely for up to two (2) business days per workweek. However, the successful candidate must be able to report to County facilities for meetings, work assignments, and/or disaster service work upon short notice, as needed and deemed appropriate. During the initial probationary period, the successful candidate may be required to work primarily onsite before establishing a hybrid work schedule.

**Application Timeline:** We look forward to reviewing your application! Please mark your calendar, the filing period for this recruitment will be open from Friday, November 13th, 2026, at 7:00 AM, through the closing date of Monday, November 16th, 2026, at 11:59 PM. You will be able to access the "Apply" function during this time only.

**ABOUT YOU**
-------------

**Our Highly Qualified Candidate:**

  
  

Our ideal CPPM I and II bring 1–3 years of hands-on experience in moderately complex capital and facilities-planning projects, with some experience in design team coordination, bid solicitation, contract award, and progress documentation. The ideal CPPM I and II will have the ability to successfully collaborate across County departments and stakeholder groups through clear, respectful communication.

  
  

Exceptionally organized, they maintain precise project documentation and distill technical and financial details into concise reports for leadership and public audiences. A resourceful problem-solver, they anticipate site-level challenges and implement compliant, cost-effective solutions, taking ownership from kickoff through closeout while adapting seamlessly between remote and onsite work.

Above all, they share our commitment to stewardship, integrity, and continuous improvement, delivering public facilities that truly serve the community.

  
  
**QUALIFICATIONS**  
  
  

**Capital Planning and Project Manager I**

**Knowledge of:**

new_jobs.title: Case Manager II
new_jobs.description:
**JOB SUMMARY**: The Case Manager II (CM II), a key member of the primary care interdisciplinary team, provides services for patients with complex care needs. This position conducts patient outreach, engagement and psychosocial service assessment, assists in developing a patient-centered care plan, is the lead implementer of Enhanced Care Management (ECM) and coordinates service referrals and delivery. The Case Manager meets clients in home, clinic, or community as appropriate or required by the specific program/site. The CM II provides services to specific populations that have multiple complex health and social services needs and often provides care outside of a traditional health center setting, such as home visits, hospitals, supportive housing sites, encampments and shelters.

This position is represented by SEIU-UHW. Salaries and benefits are set by a collective bargaining agreement (CBA), and an employee in this position must remain a member in good standing of SEIU-UHW, as defined in the CBA.

**Essential Functions**:

* Outreach, via telephone and in person at LifeLong, community and residential sites, to patients who meet case management program eligibility criteria or are prioritized by LifeLong for this service
* Proactively meet and engage with patients to build effective relationships and assess strengths and needs through use of standard intake, screening tools, and health, and social services records review
* Actively involve patients and caregivers, as appropriate, in designing and delivering services, including development of care plans, assuring alignment with patients’ values and expressed goals of care
* Provide and facilitate referrals for internal and external resources, and collaborate with the patient to complete required applications, forms, or releases of information
* Maintain a patient caseload in accordance with LifeLong standards for the specific population served or site requirements
* Utilize data registries and reports to manage caseload, meet program requirements, maintain grant deliverables, and promote high quality care
* Provide health education and training to patients, including but not limited to, harm reduction and disease risk-mitigation strategies that empower patients to manage their own health and wellness (e.g. overdose prevention, mitigating spread of communicable diseases)
* Assist patients with accessing and retaining public benefits and insurance (e.g. MediCal, SSI/SSDI, CalFresh, General Assistance, etc), and affordable/subsidized housing
* Respectfully and routinely communicate with patients, their care team members, external partners, and identified social supports
* Maintain knowledge of patients’ medical/behavioral health treatment plans and facilitate utilization of services by providing resources such as accompaniment, transportation, in-home care, reminder calls etc.
* Participate in team meetings to coordinate care, support patient goals, and reduce barriers to accessing services
* Advocate on behalf of patients to get their needs met and/or support patients to learn advocacy strategies for themselves.
* Provide case management services to patients with multiple complex acute or chronic medical or behavioral health conditions (e.g. HIV/AIDS, Hep C, congestive heart failure, severe diabetes, severe hypertension, psychosis, pregnancy, and homelessness)
* Provide general housing case management services that includes document readiness, housing problem solving, and assessments for Coordinated Entry System
* Assist with patient crisis intervention and de-escalation
* Provide and document billable services to eligible populations that result in revenue generation for LifeLong
* Keep current on community resources and social service supports to effectively serve the target population
* Document patient contacts/services in required data systems (EHR, HMIS etc.) according to LifeLong policy
* Specific activities may vary depending on the requirements of the program and funder.
* Promote diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in support of patients and staff
* Represent LifeLong positively in the community and advocate on behalf of underserved populations

**Qualifications**

* Commitment to working directly with low-income persons from diverse backgrounds in a culturally responsive manner
* Commitment to harm reduction, recovery, housing first, age-friendly and patient centered care
* Strong organizational, administrative and problem-solving skills, and ability to be flexible and adaptive to change while maintaining a positive attitude
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written skills
* Ability to prioritize tasks, work under pressure, and complete assignments in a timely manner
* Ability to seek direction/approval on essential matters, yet work independently, using professional judgment and diplomacy
* Works well in a team-oriented environment
* Conducts oneself in external settings in a way that reflects positively on your employer
* Ability to be creative, mature, proactive, and committed to continual learning and improvement in professional settings

**Job Requirements**

* High School diploma or GED
* At least two (2) years of progressively responsible work or volunteer experience in a community-based health care or social work setting or at least one (1) year of experience as a Case Manager I or equivalent position
* Proficient skills using Microsoft Office applications like Word, Excel, and Outlook, as well as the ability to work in and/or manage databases
* Access to reliable transportation with current license and insurance

**Job Preferences**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Social Work, or another Health or Human Services field
* Work or lived experience in area(s) relevant to the population to be served: e.g. perinatal, homelessness, recovery, criminal justice, elder care, palliative and end-of-life care, or behavioral health

new_jobs.description:
Summary
  
  
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, great ideas have a way of becoming great products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there’s no telling what you could accomplish. The Apple Channel Sales Program team is seeking a dynamic and highly motivated leader who can drive change for Apple Channel’s global supply chain. The Supply Chain Program Manager plays a critical role in enhancing the customer experience in Channel stores by developing and managing global strategies, owning the field team’s ordering platform and develop and execute end-to-end demand and supply plans. Success in this role is defined by measurable results in fill rate, cost efficiency, and vendor performance. You will own the metrics, report on them to leadership, and be accountable for improving them over time.
  
  
Description
  
  
Define and set global strategy for Apple Channel’s Brand Advocate Program, which helps Apple deliver an exceptional customer experience, and collaborate with key stakeholders to implement strategy and monitor performance. Own and manage the ordering platform experience for Channel Maintenance and NSO programs — triaging data issues and partnering with cross-functional teams to resolve them while developing a roadmap for future enhancements. Plan and analyze demand, inventory, and usage for the maintenance program to develop and manage weekly and quarterly supply plans. Serve as the primary point of contact with 3PL vendor, running recurring business reviews, coordinating billing and invoice approvals. Manage sourcing and stocking decisions for security hardware and other maintenance elements — lead time, minimum order quantity, unit cost, and supplier qualification. Manage ancillary retrofits globally, overseeing planning, execution, and timeline adherence across all regions to ensure consistent implementation and minimal disruption to store operations. Resolve back-order and inventory escalations across regions, and support new-region fulfillment rollouts (UAT setup, vendor onboarding, go-live validation). Identify improvement opportunities, marshal resources, and drive projects to completion to achieve targeted measurable benefits.

* 5+ years of experience in supply chain, project management, product planning, production control, and inventory management.
* Prior experience managing complex projects including setting goals, meeting tight timelines, and executing roadmap with cross-functional teams.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate and influence both internal and external stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills.

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* Very high attention to detail.

new_jobs.description:
Summary
  
  
Imagine what you could do here. World Class operational excellence is a cornerstone of Apple's ability to consistently surprise and delight our customers. The WW Materials Program Manager plays a critical role in ensuring operational success for the Procurement organization. In this role, you will be responsible for materials readiness, availability, and visibility. This is a strategic supply chain role, interacting with our Contract Manufacturers (CMs) and internal core teams, encompassing critical component planning, allocation direction, supply flexibility modeling, and materials liability management. Do you have a passion for complex supply chain operations? We hope you will consider joining our team.
  
  
Description
  
  
Do you enjoy seeing products come to life? The MPM will manage the CTB ("clear to build") process with suppliers and OEMs, ensuring that we have efficient process and clear visibility on our procurement strategy. Your successful ability to partner with OEMs and the sourcing team on material strategy will directly impact our product success. - Clear-to-Build (CTB) Management: provide visibility to materials supply, highlighting projected coverage and constraints. CTB projections govern what the Supply-Demand Managers (SDM) can commit to customers and are a key input to revenue projections provided to our C-level executives. - Partner with the CM to develop a model that incorporates the specific supply chain and materials flow details to project availability in support of our supply/demand goals. - Create allocation strategies for constrained materials by developing models across factories, programs, and lines of business. Provide allocation direction to Global Supply Managers and Apple Suppliers. - Challenge and influence Demand Planning and Strategic Sourcing teams to improve allocation and maximize revenue. - Identify E & O and other material risk, recommend critical course of action to leadership, and own the efforts to mitigate liability to the business. - Develop strategic roadmap for the phase‐out of obsolete parts and new product materials. - Prepare and communicate critical Materials updates at weekly Sustaining Executive Program reviews; maintain executive reports and summaries, providing accurate and timely data to leadership on a weekly basis. - Through a deep understanding of our commodity terms, ensure the logistical flow of materials necessary to meet production schedules, inventory control requirements, and ongoing material line support.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business, Operations, or a related analytical field.
* 3+ years of professional experience in supply chain operations, materials management, procurement, or manufacturing planning.
* Advanced analytical skills with proficiency in spreadsheet modeling (Excel/Numbers) for supply/demand matching, forecasting, and risk assessment.

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* Demonstrated experience managing Clear-to-Build (CTB), inventory allocation, or complex materials flow with Contract Manufacturers (CMs) or OEMs.
* Ability to problem-solve and influence others through relationships and data.
* Advanced modeling and predictive analytical skills; "Advanced User" of MS Excel with deep understanding of Excel techniques. VBA, SQL, Tableau, or similar data visualization tools a plus.
* Professional experience with complex supply chain, technical expertise, or prior OEM management experience preferred.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present to management required.
* International experience and Mandarin, Japanese, Vietnamese language skills a plus.

* Willingness to travel internationally as needed.

new_jobs.description:
### Position Title: Community Health Navigator II

**Department**: Operations

**Reports To**: ECM Territory Manager

**Location**: Hybrid/ Remote

**Employment Type**: Full-time

**Travel requirement:** This is a field-based position and requires substantial travel to meet with members where they live.

**About MedZed**
----------------

MedZed is a leader in delivering value-based, technology-enabled social support to a diverse population of high-cost Medicaid members who have been unreachable with telephonic outreach, disconnected from primary care, and using hospital-based services as their primary point of care. We combine innovative technologies with field-based outreach to find and engage these members. We then apply a model of care designed to re-connect them to primary care, address the Health-Related Social Needs (HRSNs) that contribute to their disengagement and present barriers to care, and provide them with the means and knowledge to take more control over their healthcare. Our interventions yield reduced Emergency Department and Inpatient utilization costs for our health plan partners and improved quality of life for their members.

### **Primary Focus:**

Independent field-based case management for moderate-to-high acuity members. To be effective, associates in this position will spend a substantial part of the work week visiting and enrolling members in the community.

**Position Overview:**
----------------------

**The Community Health Navigator II (CHN II) is an ECM care manager responsible for managing complex and high-acuity member cases, serving as a mentor to newly hired care team staff, and modeling excellence in engagement, documentation, and compliance performance. The CHN II role is focused on developing foundational care coordination skills. CHN IIs are responsible for outreach (via door knocks and telephone), assessments, quality and billable care delivery and member graduations in compliance with CalAIM, DHCS, and contracted health plan requirements.** **This role is non-clinical in nature and is an in-field position minimum 4 days a week.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------

* Manage an ECM caseload up to 50+ members.
* Complete initial and follow-up ECM assessments including Primary, Secondary, PHQ-9, and required reassessments.
* Support development and updates of individualized Care Plans
* Calls, field visits, and door knock to provide care and enroll new members.
* Build and maintain a member panel through consistent outreach.
* Coordinate referrals to health plans, providers, and community-based resources.
* Staff tables and other community partnership opportunities as requested.
* Document timely, accurate, and compliant case notes in Salesforce Health Cloud and health plan portals, as necessary.
* Participate in interdisciplinary case conferences and team huddles
* Escalate complex or high-risk member needs appropriately.
* Maintain compliance with CalAIM, DHCS, and health plan requirements.
* Meet outreach, engagement, and documentation standards.
* Attend required training and professional development.
* Support audit readiness and data tracking activities.
* Comply with all company policies and administrative requirements

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

* High School Diploma or equivalent required
* 2+ years’ experience in ECM, case management, or community health
* Demonstrated excellence in documentation and compliance.
* Ability to manage complex psychosocial and medical needs.
* Curious and relentless nature
* Commitment to do outreach via phone and in-person to enroll new members.

**Internal Promotion Criteria (CHN II CHN III):**

* Serve as a CHN II for a minimum of 12 months.
* Maintain engagement, outreach, panel size, and quality metrics for at least six consecutive months.
* Be in good standing with no active corrective action.

* **Training Delivery & Facilitation:** Conduct dynamic, interactive training sessions using diverse instructional methodologies that emphasize repetition, peer-to-peer modules, and active student "teach-backs".
* **CHW Curriculum Execution:** Facilitate the 45-to-48-hour classroom training footprint across core instructional dimensions, including client engagement, behavioral health, trauma-informed care, and toxic stress analysis.
* **Universal Training Administration:** Lead the execution of Roots Universal Training modules required for organizational onboarding:
  + *Roots History:* Anchoring new employee hires in the organization's mission, values, and community rituals.
  + *Epidemiology:* Introducing localized health disparities and health literacy trends within target zones like East Oakland.
  + *Interpersonal/Professional Skills:* Delivering the Professionalism Suite to cultivate workplace success, boundary setting, and compliance standards.
* **Mental Health First Aid Integration:** Conduct protocol-driven training and certifications in Adult Mental Health First Aid to prepare participants to respond to acute psychiatric and substance use crises.
* **Workforce Development Support:** Support specialized workforce initiatives to transition staff and community members into sustainable healthcare careers, reinforcing the CHW track as a lifelong professional path.
* **Collaborative Design & Adaptability:** Partner with subject matter experts to adapt instructional content to align with the Community Health Worker national standard frameworks.
* **MAA & Regulatory Literacy Integration:** Incorporate knowledge of Medi-Cal Administrative Activities (MAA) billing, state Medi-Cal eligibility navigation, complex care management, and mandatory reporting laws into routine instruction.
* **Impact Evaluation & Record Keeping:** Assist in evaluating training efficacy through mock office simulations and structured assessments, maintaining precise tracking systems for trainee participation, hours credit, and completion records.
* **Administrative Support:** Attend department and staff meetings as necessary to align instruction with broader Learning standard operating procedures.

Requirements:

### **Core Competencies:**

* **Presentation & Communication:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills; demonstrated ability to guide group discussions, manage professional environments, and lead community rituals.
* **Clinical/Community Framework Experience:** Proven experience implementing training within a clinical setting, healthcare navigation network, or community health framework.
* **Technical & Regulatory Proficiency:** Comfort utilizing e-learning platforms, digital tools, and electronic medical records navigation systems, while preserving critical ethical standards such as HIPAA and the ADA.
* **Project Management & Collaboration:** Strong organizational skills with a proven ability to manage multiple training cohorts, deadlines, and pre-designed curricula simultaneously.
* **Cultural Humility & Adaptability:** Ability to pivot delivery based on stakeholder needs, maintaining a firm commitment to empowering communities of African and Indigenous descent.

The Sarnova Family of companies includes Digitech Computer, Bound Tree Medical, Tri-anim Health Services and Cardio Partners.
  
  
Digitech is a leading provider of advanced billing and technology services to the EMS transport industry. Since its founding in 1984, Digitech has refined its software platform to create a cloud-based billing and business intelligence solution that monitors and automates the entire EMS revenue lifecycle. Digitech leverages its proprietary technology to offer fully outsourced services that maximize collections, protect compliance, and deliver results for clients.
  
  
**Summary:**  
The Call Center Specialist plays a key role in delivering high quality customer service within a fully remote, high volume call center environment. This individual is responsible for handling incoming patient calls with professionalism, empathy, and accuracy. Success in this role requires the ability to remain calm under pressure, manage competing priorities, and provide clear, compassionate support to patients navigating billing related questions.
  
  
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**  

* Answer a high volume of incoming patient calls in a remote call center environment, providing prompt, courteous, and accurate assistance
* Listen actively and demonstrate empathy while addressing patient questions, concerns, and billing inquiries
* Evaluate caller needs and determine the correct resolution path while following client specific rules, workflows, and service expectations
* Handle all incoming calls by gathering information, resolving issues when possible, and completing any necessary follow up actions, which may include sending emails, obtaining additional details, and returning calls to provide a full resolution
* Research issues by reviewing account details, contacting third parties, or gathering additional documentation as needed
* Complete follow up actions such as placing outbound calls, sending emails, or faxing requested information to support full resolution
* Maintain detailed, accurate documentation of all calls and actions taken in the patient account system
* Protect confidentiality by strictly adhering to HIPAA regulations and Digitech’s compliance standards at all times
* Meet or exceed established daily quotas
* Manage workload efficiently while remaining flexible and adaptable in a fast paced, high volume environment
* Contribute to a positive team culture by communicating effectively, asking questions when needed, and seeking continuous improvement
* Additional job duties as assigned

**Skills/Experience Required:**  

* Education: High School Diploma or Equivalent required
* Bilingual (English/Spanish) preferred
* Proficient computer skills, including working knowledge of MS Outlook, Word, and Excel
* Familiarity with insurance billing is a plus; comprehensive training is provided
* Ability to type a minimum of 40 WPM with accuracy
* Maintains composure under pressure and remains calm in high volume or challenging situations
* Able to manage a high workload efficiently while meeting tight deadlines
* Demonstrated ability to handle sensitive conversations professionally and uphold a positive company image during all phone interactions
* Strong problem solving skills, including the ability to identify issues, ask the right questions, and determine appropriate resolutions
* Clear, professional communication skills with the ability to explain information and solutions courteously
* Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy in documentation and call handling
* Skilled at multitasking, organizing, and prioritizing work to ensure timely completion of all responsibilities
* Reliable, punctual, and dependable with a strong commitment to team success
* Ability to independently manage all aspects of the job role including required goals and business practices in a remote environment

Sarnova is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We offer a competitive salary, commensurate with experience, along with a comprehensive benefits package, including 401(k) Plan. EO/M/F/Veterans/Disabled.
  
  
Our mission is to be the best partner for those who save and improve patients’ lives. Excellence in delivering upon our mission is dependent upon having a diverse team that is empowered to bring their full, authentic self to work each day. We strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve, and we are passionate about creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity.
