new_jobs.title: Customer Onboarding Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Customer Onboarding Manager**
===============================

**Location:** Remote, United States

**Experience:** 3–5 years

**About Tessera Labs**
----------------------

Tessera Labs is redefining how enterprises modernize their most complex systems. Backed by Foundation Capital and built by leaders in AI (Artificial Intelligence) and enterprise transformation, Tessera delivers governed, multi-agent AI built specifically for ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) modernization. Tessera compresses ERP modernization from years to weeks.

**About the Role**
------------------

The Customer Onboarding Manager owns every new customer's path from the first handoff by our GTM (Go-To-Market) team to the day the customer is live in production. Your job is to make that path shorter, more predictable, and easier for the customer.

Today, the slowest part of a deal comes after the first sales conversation. Customers need internal approvals before a POC (Proof of Concept) can start: security questionnaires, compliance reviews, infrastructure and architecture questions, and procurement steps. Most of the delay sits on the customer's side, and some sits on ours. You will close both gaps.

You join the customer from the first call, build a shared onboarding plan, and track every open item until it is done. You chase approvals on the customer's side and pull in the right people on ours: GTM, TPM (Technical Project Management), Security, Compliance, and Infrastructure. You do not answer deep technical questions yourself; you make sure the right expert answers them on time.

You will also find the patterns behind the delays and fix them, turning one-off efforts into a repeatable onboarding process.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**End-to-End Onboarding Ownership**

* Take the handoff from GTM and join customer calls from the start of each engagement.
* Build a shared onboarding plan with each customer covering security review, compliance review, infrastructure questions, procurement, POC, and production go-live.
* Own the timeline, open items, and next steps for several customer onboardings at the same time.
* Keep the customer and internal teams aligned on what is done, what is blocked, and who owns each next step.

**Customer-Side Approvals**

* Map each customer's internal approval path early: who signs off on security, compliance, architecture, legal, and procurement.
* Follow up consistently with customer stakeholders to keep approvals moving.
* Help customers get what their reviewers need, such as completed questionnaires, compliance evidence, and architecture documents.
* Spot stalled approvals early and escalate through the right customer and Tessera contacts.

**Internal Coordination**

* Route customer questions to the right Tessera team (TPM, Security, Compliance, Infrastructure, or GTM) and track them to a committed answer date.
* Make sure handoffs between teams happen without dropped items or repeated questions to the customer.
* Identify internal gaps that slow onboarding, such as missing documents, slow answers, or unclear ownership, and drive fixes with the owning team.

**Process and Reporting**

* Build and maintain a repeatable onboarding playbook, including stage definitions, checklists, templates, and handoff criteria.
* Track onboarding metrics, such as time from GTM handoff to POC start and from POC to production, and report trends to leadership.
* Keep a reusable library of common customer requests and answers with the owning teams so later onboardings move faster.
* Use AI tools to speed up tracking, follow-ups, and reporting.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 3–5 years of experience in customer onboarding, implementation management, customer success, project coordination, or a similar customer-facing role at a B2B (business-to-business) software company.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the confidence to lead calls with customer stakeholders and follow up without being prompted.
* A record of running several customer engagements at once and keeping each one on schedule.
* Experience building processes from scratch, such as playbooks, checklists, and trackers, and getting other teams to use them.
* Strong organization and follow-through, with a habit of clear written status updates.
* Basic understanding of what enterprise security reviews, compliance requirements, and cloud deployments involve. You need to understand the questions well enough to route them; you do not need to answer them.
* Comfort working across teams where you have influence but not direct authority.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience onboarding enterprise customers through security reviews, vendor due diligence, or procurement at an enterprise SaaS (Software as a Service) or AI company.
* Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 (System and Organization Controls 2) or ISO/IEC 27001 (International Organization for Standardization / International Electrotechnical Commission 27001).

Tailgate Connect (TGC) is a veteran-owned tailgate experience marketplace. We connect fans with hosted tailgates at NFL, college football, and concert events across the country.

We're hiring someone to own the customer success journey, from a potential customer’s first question to the moment they're under the tent on game day. Our standards, message templates and support dashboard are already in place. You'll run them every day, and you'll be the person who updates them as we grow.

**What you'll own**

You own every standard that touches a TgC customer's journey: how we communicate to them, when we reach out, and how we resolve their issues.

* Our customer message templates for text and email.
* Our case system and the rules behind it.
* The CS playbook for anyone covering the desk.
* A debrief after each game weekend on what to improve.

***Responsibilities***

**Game day**

* Send the morning reminders to every guest with a tailgate that day, including location-change notices when a host has moved.
* Watch the live board as tailgates open across time zones, and get guests to the right tent in the event they can't find it.

new_jobs.title: Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
***We're looking for an experienced Account Manager with a strong background in payments to join our growing team at Thredd.***

*You'll work with key clients across the US helping them succeed while playing a pivotal role in growing our business and shaping the future of payments.*

***If you're passionate about building strong client relationships, driving commercial growth and uncovering new opportunities in the evolving payments landscape, this is your chance to make a real impact.***

* Develop account plans to understand client objectives, identify growth opportunities and strengthen long-term partnerships
* Drive commercial growth through cross-selling, upselling and identifying opportunities to expand existing client relationships.
* Lead regular client business reviews, analysing performance metrics and analysing trends to identify opportunities and deliver value.

* Monitor transaction volumes, account performance and market trends to identify risks, growth opportunities and areas for improvement.
* Proactively manage client expectations, resolve sensitive issues and ensure a consistently high standard of client service.
* Develop a deep understanding of clients' business models and the payments landscape to anticipate needs, identify growth opportunities, deliver exceptional client experiences and build long-term, commercially successful partnerships.

**What you'll bring as an experienced Account Manager**

* Proven experience in account management within payments or fintech, with a strong understanding of payment processing; issuer processing experience is highly desirable.
* Excellent written and verbal communication.
* A track record of building and maintaining client relationships.
* Strong experience driving revenue growth, identifying cross-selling and upselling opportunities and managing contract negotiations.
* A client first mindset, with the ability to manage complex or sensitive relationships and drive long-term satisfaction and retention.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Confidence managing challenging conversations, resolving conflicts diplomatically and influencing stakeholders to achieve positive outcomes.
* A collaborative, proactive approach, with the ability to work cross-functionally and influence teams in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
* A commercially driven and adaptable mindset, combining strategic thinking, attention to detail and professionalism under pressure.

**Where you'll work**  
Our working model varies depending on the specific role and team requirements. We strive to provide flexibility whilst ensuring that each position is best supported for optimal collaboration and performance.  
  
**About us**  
Thredd is the trusted next-gen payments partner for innovators looking to modernise their payments offering. Certified by Mastercard, Visa and Diners & Discover, we process billions of debit, prepaid, and credit transactions annually, supporting consumer and corporate fintechs, digital banks, and embedded finance providers across the globe. Our unique offering is our client-centric approach, combining hands-on support with modern, reliable, and scalable technology.  
Our assured solution accelerates the development and delivery of consumer and corporate payments components embedded within digital banks, as well as for expense management, B2B payments, crypto, lending, credit, Buy Now Pay Later, FX, remittance, and open banking innovators.  
Since 2007, Thredd has enabled market leaders through our highly reliable, secure, and scalable platform and supported many of our client's growth journeys - from early-stage startup through to globally recognized unicorns, including Monzo, Revolut, and Starling.

Here at Thredd, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected and empowered. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences and identities. If you require any adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know and we would be happy to support you.  
  
**Our Values**  
Our values-driven culture is what unites our teams globally and our teams is what drives our success;  
Here are what the values mean for you in this Account Manager position;

* Own it and deliver – Taking responsibility for your own performance and being successful in your own role
* Collaborate purposefully – Building trusted relationships with colleagues, supporting activities and being successful together
* Think differently – Asking questions to check understanding and sharing your ideas to support continuous improvement
* Act courageously – Stepping out of your comfort zone and embracing change to help you learn and grow

new_jobs.description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.

Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

Varian Medical Systems, a Siemens Healthineers company is hiring a Clinical Training Specialist (CSL) for the Boston, MA and Albany, NY area supporting Varian Interventional Solutions (VIS) by providing in‑person case coverage, clinical education, and first-line technical support for VIS products. This role trains and guides physicians, nurses, and hospital staff on proper product use, assists during procedures in a hands‑off clinical support capacity, and ensures equipment, disposables, and procedural documentation are fully managed. The specialist also supports product installations, addresses customer training needs, contributes to medical affairs activities, and represents VIS at trainings, demos, and industry events. The position requires strong clinical knowledge (IR/CT, OR, sterile technique), excellent communication skills, the ability to work in fast‑paced procedural environments, and regional travel of approximately 50%.

**What You will do:**

***Provide in-person case coverage***

* Ensure product/s and ancillary components are available for each case.
* Complete and process all procedure related paperwork as required.
* Track and report all customer complaints.
* Ensure physicians and staff have the most current information available.
* Manage a disposable inventory sufficient to cover assigned case load.
* Bring products (including Microwave and Cryoablation generators) to cases as required.

***Train and educate physicians and hospital staff on use of assigned VIS products***

* Provide on-site clinical support during procedures while maintaining a “hands off” posture in relation to direct patient contact.
* Interact with customers and functional organizations to determine their training needs and use engineering documentation such as Operators Manuals and DFUs to develop content of courses.
* May coordinate or lead customer and/or employee training classes.
* May also conduct large group presentations at seminars, training programs, and trade shows.
* May also provide demo support to local, regional and national customer trade events.

***Provide first line product technical support***

* Perform new installation support to ensure products are working as specified.
* Provide first line technical service support via Engineering or Field Service Engineer oversight, when necessary.

***Collaborate with the VIS Medical Affairs Team***

* Assist Medical Education, Medical Information, and Medical Science Liaisons if required.
* Document day to day interactions with physician customers.
* Provide competitive product performance information to headquarters marketing or engineering groups.

**What You will have:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in related field preferred.
* Clinical Background – IR/CT Technician, Operating Room Nurse or Surgical Technician preferred.
* Experience/Knowledge of IR suite, Operating Room Protocol and Sterile Technique.
* Experience in supporting vascular procedures highly regarded.
* Experience in supporting tissue ablation procedures highly regarded.
* Ability to work in a high-intensity, fast-paced environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Detail oriented with excellent organizational skills.
* Analytical with an ability/desire to solve problems.
* Team player.
* Ability to lift approx. 150 pounds
* Ability to travel regional and locally (approximately 50%).

***Vendor Credentialing Requirements***

* Many Varian clients require employees and representatives to meet certain “Vendor Credentialing” requirements before they will be allowed to have access to their sites.
* This position requires having full access to client sites to perform the essential functions of this position.
* Unless prohibited by law, candidate must meet all Vendor Credentialing requirements necessary to have full client access, and must continue to meet those requirements during the course of employment in this position.
* These requirements vary by client and may include, but are not limited to: Proof of valid identification (photo, driver’s license, SSN), Criminal background checks, Drug screens, Immunizations (Hep B, MMR, Varicella, Influenza, Tetanus), Annual TB testing.
